title.en: Visitor levy powers should be in place by March 2028 in England, ministers say – UK politics live
title.zh: 酒店业担心“旅游税”计划可能导致失业

summary.en: The hospitality industry is concerned about reports that there will be no cap on the levy that mayors can impose, following proposals by mayors like Andy Burnham and Steve Rotheram to introduce an overnight visitor levy.
summary.zh: 酒店业担心，据报道，市长们可以征收的税款将没有上限，此前安迪·伯纳姆和史蒂夫·罗瑟勒姆等市长提出了征收过夜游客税的计划。

body.en: Downing Street gives more details of plan, saying it would be charged as a percentage of accommodation costs, not a flat fee Tourists in England face nightly levy on hotel and Airbnb stays under new plans The Centre for Cities , a thinktank that focuses on promoting growth in cities, has welcomed the government’s plans to let mayors in England impose a tourism tax. This is from its chief executive, Andrew Carter. The overnight visitor levy is a great step forward for fiscal devolution. This marks the first time that mayors in England have gained more autonomy over funding. The overnight visitor levy means places will get rewarded for doing what they need to attract more visitors and grow their local economies. Labour’s solution to every issue is always to hike taxes. This is just the latest method they’ve found to squeeze more money out of hardworking families and the economy. The hospitality industry has already been hit by colossal business rates hikes thanks to Labour, on top of their Jobs Tax and employment red tape that have driven up costs. Now hotels and other businesses face another blow that will harm local economies and discourage local tourism. VAT is already charged at 20% on hotels - much higher than in other countries - and now they’ll pay VAT on this tourism tax too: a Labour double whammy. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该行业对市长征收的征税不会设定上限的报道感到担忧。早上好。去年，时任大曼彻斯特市长的安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）和他的密友兼盟友利物浦城市地区市长史蒂夫·罗瑟拉姆（Steve Rotheram）敦促政府允许英格兰市长征收他们所谓的游客税。伯纳姆和罗瑟拉姆正在推开一扇敞开的门。今年 5 月，凯尔·斯塔默 (Keir Starmer) 在国王的讲话中纳入了过夜游客征税法案的计划。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The proposed 'tourist tax' raises concerns for the hospitality industry, particularly regarding its potential impact on jobs. This situation calls for careful consideration of how economic policies affect livelihoods. Micah 6:8 reminds us of the importance of acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God, principles that should guide decisions...
reflection.zh: 拟议的“旅游税”引起了酒店业的担忧，特别是其对就业的潜在影响。这种情况需要仔细考虑经济政策如何影响生计。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，要秉持公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑行走，这些原则应指导那些影响企业和工人的决策。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Orthodox church sends medieval prince’s remains to Russian troops in Ukraine
title.zh: 东正教会将中世纪王子遗骸送往乌克兰俄军

summary.en: The Russian Orthodox Church has sent a fragment of the right hand of Dmitry Donskoy, a medieval warrior prince revered for his 14th-century victory over the Golden Horde, to Russian troops in occupied eastern Ukraine. The church stated that the relic is intended to "spiritually strengthen" soldiers and aid them in...
summary.zh: 俄罗斯东正教会已将一位中世纪战士王子德米特里·顿斯科伊的遗骸部分送往乌克兰东部占领区，这位王子因其在1380年战胜蒙古金帐汗国而备受俄罗斯尊敬。教会表示，圣物旨在“精神上巩固”士兵，并帮助他们取得胜利。

body.en: Part of Dmitry Donskoy’s right hand sent to ‘spiritually strengthen’ soldiers Europe live – latest updates The Russian Orthodox church has sent a fragment of a medieval warrior prince’s remains to troops fighting in Ukraine, saying the relic would “spiritually strengthen” soldiers and help them achieve victory. A reliquary containing part of the right hand of Dmitry Donskoy, the 14th-century prince revered in Russia for his victory over the Mongolian Golden Horde in 1380, has been taken to Russian-occupied eastern Ukraine and is now being transported along the frontline. Continue reading...
body.zh: 德米特里·顿斯科伊右手的一部分送给了士兵“精神上的力量” 欧洲直播 – 最新消息 俄罗斯东正教教堂将中世纪武士王子的遗骸碎片送给了在乌克兰作战的部队，称这件遗物将“精神上增强”士兵并帮助他们取得胜利。一个装有德米特里·顿斯科伊 (Dmitry Donskoy) 右手一部分的圣物盒已被带到俄罗斯占领的乌克兰东部，目前正沿着前线运送。德米特里·顿斯科伊是 14 世纪的王子，因 1380 年战胜蒙古金帐汗国而受到俄罗斯的尊敬。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the midst of conflict, religious symbols are often invoked to bolster morale and inspire action. The Russian Orthodox Church's decision to send a relic of Dmitry Donskoy to soldiers in Ukraine highlights how faith can be intertwined with national and military endeavors. This act prompts reflection on the complex relationship between spiritual belief and...
reflection.zh: 在冲突之中，宗教象征常被用来鼓舞士气、激励行动。俄罗斯东正教会决定将一位中世纪王子德米特里·顿斯科伊的圣物送给乌克兰的士兵，这凸显了信仰如何与国家及军事行动交织在一起。这一举动促使人们反思精神信仰与世俗冲突之间复杂的关系，以及在战争时期人类对力量和意义的不懈追求。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Russia’s actions have strengthened European case for boosting defence spending, says Nato chief – as it happened
title.zh: 俄无人机袭击乌克兰仓库和港口致至少九人死亡

summary.en: Russian drone strikes targeted warehouses and ports in Ukraine, resulting in at least nine deaths. This follows news that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's plane was nearly hit by a drone while departing Moldova. Separately, NATO allies reportedly thwarted a Russian attempt to deploy a secret weapon designed...
summary.zh: 俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰的仓库和港口，造成至少九人死亡。此前有报道称，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基的飞机在离开摩尔多瓦时险些被一架无人机击中。另外，据报道，北约盟友挫败了一项俄罗斯试图部署旨在破坏海底电缆的秘密武器的计划。

body.en: Mark Rutte said that Europeans ‘increasingly understand’ the need for their countries to take ‘greater responsibility for our own security’ Addressing German ambassadors, Wadephul repeats that the Russian threat “has reached our doorstep and it’s tangible.” He adds: “The Russian attempted attack at the airport in Leipzig is only the most recent incident in a string of constantly growing Russian aggression against Europe and against Nato. Russia and its partners operate with a global network against our interests and in favour of an own imperialist claim to great power status." Continue reading...
body.zh: 这次袭击是在乌克兰总统泽连斯基的飞机本周离开摩尔多瓦时差点被无人机击中之后发生的。与此同时，路透社报道称，北约盟国中断了俄罗斯的一次阴谋训练，以释放一种秘密武器，该武器旨在在不留下任何痕迹的情况下禁用关键的海底电缆。连接斯瓦尔巴群岛和挪威大陆的两条 1,400 公里长的海底光缆位于海面以下 2,700 米深处。它们携带着从 SvalSat 卫星地面站下载的大量卫星数据，该卫星地面站是世界上最大的卫星地面站，也是 NASA 近太空网络的一部分。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of drone strikes and near-misses paints a grim picture of escalating conflict. In such moments, the temptation to respond with equal force is strong. Yet, Scripture calls us to a higher path: 'Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.' This principle challenges us to seek ways to break the cycle of violence, even when faced with...
reflection.zh: 无人机袭击和险些被击中的消息描绘了一幅冲突升级的严峻图景。在这样的时刻，以牙还牙的冲动是强烈的。然而，圣经呼唤我们走上一条更高的道路：“不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。”这一原则挑战我们，即使面对侵略，也要寻求打破暴力循环的方法。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Trump’s promise of $5,000 ‘dividend’ for US citizens after midterms decried as ‘bribery’
title.zh: 特朗普承诺为美国公民提供5000美元“红利”，被斥为“贿赂”

summary.en: Critics react with incredulity to Donald Trump's bid for Republican votes, pointing to the potential $1.2tn cost on top of the existing national debt. Trump promised a $5,000 "Trump dividend" for every US citizen if Republicans retain control of Congress in the November midterm elections.
summary.zh: 批评者对唐纳德·特朗普争取共和党选票的举动表示难以置信，并指出其可能在现有国债之上增加1.2万亿美元的成本。特朗普承诺，如果共和党在11月的国会中期选举中保住控制权，将为每位美国公民提供5000美元的“特朗普红利”。

body.en: Critics react to bid for Republican votes with incredulity and point to potential $1.2tn cost atop existing national debt Donald Trump’s promise of a $5,000 “Trump dividend” for every US citizen if Republicans retain control of the US Congress in November’s midterm elections has sparked incredulity and accusations of bribery. “If the Republicans win, you win with us and you get $5,000,” Trump said during the unprecedented Republican midterm convention in Dallas. “It will be called the Trump dividend.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 批评人士对争取共和党选票表示怀疑，并指出，如果共和党在 11 月中期选举中保留对美国国会的控制权，唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 承诺，如果共和党在 11 月的中期选举中保留对美国国会的控制权，那么在现有国债的基础上，潜在的成本将达到 1.2 万亿美元，唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 承诺将向每个美国公民发放 5,000 美元的“特朗普红利”，这引发了怀疑和贿赂指控。特朗普在达拉斯举行的史无前例的共和党中期代表大会上表示：“如果共和党获胜，你和我们一起获胜，你将获得 5,000 美元。” “这将被称为特朗普红利。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The promise of a significant financial "dividend" tied to election outcomes raises questions about the integrity of political promises. Micah 6:8 calls us to "act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with our God," principles that challenge leaders to prioritize the common good over political expediency.
reflection.zh: 将巨额财政“红利”与选举结果挂钩的承诺，引发了对政治承诺诚信的质疑。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行”，这些原则要求领导人将公共利益置于政治权宜之上。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: North Korea spends war windfall on arms, infrastructure
title.zh: 朝鲜将战争红利用于军备和基础设施建设

summary.en: The war in Ukraine and North Korea's alliance with Moscow have provided an economic boost to the country, enabling the regime to fund long-desired projects, including military spending and infrastructure development.
summary.zh: 乌克兰战争以及朝鲜与莫斯科的结盟为朝鲜带来了经济上的提振，使该政权得以推进一系列长期以来渴望的项目，包括军事开支和基础设施建设。

body.en:
The Ukraine war and Pyongyang's alliance with Moscow have delivered an economic boost to North Korea, allowing the regime to pursue a range of long-desired projects.

North Korean leader Kim Jong Un is spending the money that his troops have earned fighting in Ukraine to fund a long wish list of projects that were previously beyond his financial reach.

South Korea's National Intelligence Service estimated in May that Pyongyang received a minimum of $7.7 billion (€6.6 billion) in financial aid and economic value from Russia in the preceding three years for committing men and materiel to Moscow's war against Ukraine — and potentially as much as $14 billion.

That is a significant amount given that the North's GDP for 2024 stood at $26.6 billion.

Kim's support for Russia has been lucrative, and a slew of reports are now identifying where that money is being spent.

A portion of the funds is being put aside for the Regional Development 20x10 Policy, unveiled in January 2024 and which aims to construct modern industrial facilities in 20 regional cities per year for the next 10 years to improve living standards outside Pyongyang.

More civil programs are being designed, observers say, although most appear to be earmarked for the "elites" who reside in Pyongyang.

"Before the alliance with Russia, the general infrastructure was poor due to a mixture of economic mismanagement and sanctions," said Martyn Williams, senior fellow for the Korea program at the Stimson Center in Washington DC.

"With the breakdown in consensus on the United Nations Security Council and renewed trade with China and Russia, things are starting to move along now," he told DW.

"There are several large programs to build factories and hospitals across the country, [Kim] has ordered the development of entire new districts of Pyongyang and there's a rural housing project building tens of thousands of rural homes," he said, along with investment in "the modernization of several sectors of the economy."

There are, however, structural problems that still need to be overcome, he said.

"There is investment going into building, but the large new hospital in central Pyongyang was built some time ago and sat unused for a while, until medicines and equipment could be procured," he said. "North Korea is great at building, but keeping it running is the key — so we look to see if that will happen."

More of the financial windfall is clearly being put into the military. On Wednesday, the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) said it had identified a new uranium enrichment facility at the Yongbyon Nuclear Complex with an estimated 28 cascades of centrifuges.

The IAEA estimated that the facility would permit the regime to produce 85 kilograms of weapons-grade highly enriched uranium a...
body.zh: 乌克兰战争和平壤与莫斯科的联盟促进了朝鲜的经济发展，使该政权能够实施一系列渴望已久的项目。 朝鲜领导人金正恩正在将军队在乌克兰作战赚来的钱用于资助一长串此前超出其财力的项目清单。 韩国国家情报局5月份估计，平壤在过去三年中从俄罗斯获得了至少77亿美元（66亿欧元）的财政援助和经济价值，因为它向莫斯科对乌克兰的战争投入了人员和物资，而且可能高达140亿美元。 考虑到朝鲜 2024 年的 GDP 为 266 亿美元，这个数字相当可观。 金正恩对俄罗斯的支持是有利可图的，现在有大量报告正在确定这些钱的去向。 其中一部分资金将用于 2024 年 1 月公布的区域发展 20x10 政策，该政策旨在未来 10 年内每年在 20 个区域城市建设现代化工业设施，以提高平壤以外地区的生活水平。 观察人士称，更多的民用项目正在设计中，尽管大多数项目似乎是专门针对居住在平壤的“精英”的。 华盛顿特区史汀生中心朝鲜项目高级研究员马丁·威廉姆斯表示：“在与俄罗斯结盟之前，由于经济管理不善和制裁等原因，总体基础设施很差。” 他对德国之声表示：“随着联合国安理会共识的破裂以及与中国和俄罗斯的贸易恢复，事情现在开始取得进展。” 他说：“全国有几个建设工厂和医院的大型计划，金正恩已下令开发平壤的整个新区，还有一个农村住房项目，建设数万套农村住房，”以及对“多个经济部门现代化”的投资。 但他表示，仍有一些结构性问题需要克服。 他说：“建设方面有投资，但平壤市中心的大型新医院是前一段时间建成的，在采购药品和设备之前闲置了一段时间。” “朝鲜擅长建设，但保持其运转才是关键——所以我们看看这是否会发生。” 更多的意外之财显然被投入了军队。周三，国际原子能机构 (IAEA) 表示，已在宁边核电站发现了一座新的铀浓缩设施，估计有 28 级离心机。 国际原子能机构估计，该设施将使该政权能够生产 85 公斤武器级高浓缩铀和...

reflection.en: The news from North Korea paints a stark picture of resources being channeled into military might and infrastructure, rather than human flourishing. Isaiah's prophecy offers a vision of a different path, where weapons are transformed into tools for peace and cultivation, a stark contrast to the current reality of escalating arms. May we hold onto the hope...
reflection.zh: 来自朝鲜的新闻描绘了一幅严峻的图景：资源被导向军事力量和基础设施建设，而非人类的繁荣。以赛亚的预言提供了一条不同道路的愿景，即武器被转化为和平与耕作的工具，这与当前军备不断升级的现实形成了鲜明对比。 愿我们坚守希望，相信列国终将从战争的工具转向和平的工具，体现出更深邃的智慧和对所有人的关怀。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
title.zh: 特朗普称若共和党赢得中期选举，每位成年美国人将获得5000美元

summary.en: Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.
summary.zh: 美国总统在一次党派大会上发表讲话，但没有提供该计划如何运作或资金来源的细节。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump says he would offer every adult American a $5,000 (£3,700) payout if Republicans win both chambers of Congress in November's midterm elections – a plan that would cost more than a trillion dollars.

The offer was made in a speech at the party's first-ever convention in the middle of a US presidential term.

He gave no details on how it would work or be funded – saying only that the money would have to be spent in the US. Vice-President JD Vance has linked the plan to the revenue that Trump has raised from US tariffs on imported goods.

Democrats labelled it an "empty promise" and others questioned whether such a pledge was legal or feasible.

It may be the first time a US president offered such a payout to Americans, in the context of an election year plea to get out and vote.

The idea drew raucous applause at the convention and Trump seemed to relish the moment.

There are nearly 270 million American adults, meaning a $5,000 payout would cost the US government some $1.3 trillion.

Questions have begun to be raised about whether his plan is feasible – especially as prices rise in the US, partially as a result of the war that the US and Israel started with Iran in February.

Iran's retaliation has included attacks against US bases and allies in the Gulf – but crucially it has largely closed the Strait of Hormuz, through which about a fifth of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas used to transit.

The blockage has caused fluctuations in oil prices worldwide and Trump has faced pressure from his party to end the war.

On Wednesday, the US president warned his supporters that the war would not end until after the midterms and that oil prices would not come down until then.

He made the comments ahead of his speech in Texas, repeating it at the convention where he argued that short-term economic pain was worth it to prevent Tehran from developing nuclear weapons.

Trump's long speech at the Republican convention in Dallas, Texas, touched on the core of the conflict – the impact on Americans' standard of living. His pledge to increase their spending power drew raucous applause in the hall.

"If the Republicans win the House of Representatives and the United States Senate, both of them," Trump said, "I will issue a dividend to every adult citizen in the United States of America for $5,000."

"We don't want you going to China, to Germany. You got to spend the money in the United States of America." It is not clear how the spending would be monitored.

The BBC has asked the White House for further clarification on how Trump's plan would work.

One former Republican strategist and pollster said the promise should be firmly seen in the context of an election that is now less than two months away.

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，如果共和党在 11 月中期选举中赢得国会参众两院，他将为每位成年美国人提供 5,000 美元（3,700 英镑）的奖金，这一计划将花费超过 1 万亿美元。 这一有争议的提议是在美国总统任期中期举行的该党首次代表大会上的演讲中提出的。 他没有详细说明该计划将如何运作或资金从何而来，只是说这笔钱必须在美国使用。 民主党人很快将其称为“空头承诺”，其他人则质疑这样的承诺是否合法。 美国有近 2.7 亿成年人，这意味着 5,000 美元的支出将使美国政府损失约 1.3 万亿美元。 人们开始质疑他的计划是否可行，尤其是在美国物价上涨的情况下，部分原因是美国和以色列二月份与伊朗发动的战争所造成的后果。 伊朗的报复行动包括袭击美国在海湾的基地和盟友，但最重要的是，它基本上关闭了霍尔木兹海峡，世界上约五分之一的石油和液化天然气都用来运输该海峡。 封锁导致全球油价波动，特朗普面临党内要求结束战争的压力。 周三，美国总统警告他的支持者，战争要到中期选举之后才会结束，油价在此之前不会下跌。 他在德克萨斯州发表演讲之前发表了上述言论，并在大会上重申了这一点，他认为为了阻止德黑兰发展核武器，短期的经济痛苦是值得的。 特朗普在得克萨斯州达拉斯举行的共和党全国代表大会上发表的长篇演讲触及了冲突的核心——对美国人生活水平的影响以及他提高美国人消费能力的承诺，在会场赢得了热烈的掌声。 特朗普表示：“如果共和党赢得众议院和参议院的控制权，我将向美国每一位成年公民发放 5000 美元的股息。” “我们不希望你去中国、德国。你必须把钱花在美利坚合众国。”目前尚不清楚如何监控支出。 这并不是特朗普第一次承诺支付此类款项——他此前曾提议通过关税收入提供 2000 美元的支票。 过去其他美国政客也曾承诺以经济奖励来换取选举的成功。 例如，佐治亚州的民主党人承诺，如果他们的政党在 Covid-19 大流行最严重的时候控制参议院，将提供 2,000 美元的救济金。 在美国，国会授权支出，总统在达拉斯的演讲中没有透露他是否计划就这些付款请求此类批准 - 他...

reflection.en: The promise of a $5,000 payout to every adult American, if Republicans win the midterms, is a bold claim. However, the lack of detail on funding and implementation raises concerns about its practicality and potential for being an empty promise. This echoes the biblical caution against dishonest dealings, reminding us to seek integrity and transparency in...
reflection.zh: 如果共和党赢得中期选举，向每位成年美国人发放5000美元的承诺是一个大胆的说法。然而，缺乏资金来源和实施细节的说明，引发了对其可行性和可能成为空头支票的担忧。这呼应了圣经中关于警惕欺诈行为的告诫，提醒我们在所有财务事务中都要追求诚信和透明，尤其是那些影响公共利益的事情。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Are electric vehicles really bad for the environment?
title.zh: 电动汽车真的对环境有害吗？

summary.en: Some German politicians are calling for a delay to the EU plan to phase out gas-powered vehicles, citing concerns about the overall carbon footprint of electric cars. However, a comprehensive view still indicates that EVs are more climate-friendly.
summary.zh: 一些德国政界人士呼吁推迟欧盟淘汰燃油车的计划，认为汽车应根据其整个碳足迹来评判。然而，全面的考量仍然表明电动汽车对气候更加友好。

body.en:
Some German politicians are calling for a delay to the EU plan to phase out gas-powered vehicles, saying cars must be judged on the entire carbon footprint. But the full picture still says EVs are more climate friendly.

"The EU's car lie" — Germany's Bild tabloid newspaper didn't mince words when it reported on what it called the European Union's "dangerous" claim that electric vehicles were carbon neutral .

Markus Söder , the conservative state premier of Bavaria — home to major automotive brands like Audi , BMW and   Mercedes-Benz — was equally direct. Writing on social media , he called for an end to "the EU's phaseout of internal combustion engines" set for 2035. Stepping away from the phaseout, he said, would now be backed by "science."

Söder and Bild were reacting to a new report by the Technical University of Munich (TUM) , which outlined what it considered to be a major flaw in the EU's climate strategy: the fact that its vehicle emissions regulation only focuses on CO2 emissions from exhaust gases and that battery-electric vehicles are considered "climate-neutral."

The report stated that battery-electric vehicles reduce carbon emissions by only "41% on average" over combustion engine vehicles, with the EU regulation failing to take into account emissions generated by other factors like manufacturing and electricity mix.

Gas-powered vehicles were at a disadvantage, the report concluded, suggesting emissions should be counted over a vehicle's entire life cycle, from the materials used to build a car to the fuel that makes it run. Credit could be given for the use of green steel , for instance, or recovering raw materials through recycling.

It highlighted several major car manufacturers that support this approach, including BMW, Audi and Volkswagen — all major institutional donors at TUM .

Georg Bieker, who researches the environmental impact of electric and gas-powered cars at the US-based International Council on Clean Transportation (ICCT) think tank, said TUM's analysis didn't offer any new insights. He, and other climate and mobility experts, pointed out that the importance of life-cycle assessments was already well known.

Bieker co-authored a 2025 study examining the global warming potential of passenger cars sold in the EU which took into account their entire life cycle, from the production of the vehicle to its fuel consumption and maintenance. It found that the emissions generated by battery-electric vehicles are on average 73% lower than gasoline cars, and up to 78% when using only renewable electricity. Similar studies, including from the EU and the International Energy Agency, came up with emissions reductions of between 60%-66%. The Germany Environment Ministry said modern vehicles could...
body.zh: 一些德国政界人士呼吁推迟欧盟逐步淘汰汽油动力汽车的计划，称必须根据整个碳足迹来判断汽车。但总体情况仍然表明电动汽车对气候更加友好。 “欧盟的汽车谎言”——德国《图片报》小报在报道欧盟关于电动汽车碳中和的“危险”说法时毫不拐弯抹角。 巴伐利亚州是奥迪、宝马和梅赛德斯-奔驰等主要汽车品牌的所在地，保守派州州长马库斯·索德 (Markus Söder) 也同样直接。他在社交媒体上撰文，呼吁结束“欧盟定于 2035 年逐步淘汰内燃机”的计划。他表示，放弃逐步淘汰现在将得到“科学”的支持。 Söder 和 Bild 是针对慕尼黑工业大学 (TUM) 的一份新报告做出的反应，该报告概述了欧盟气候战略中的一个重大缺陷：其车辆排放法规仅关注废气中的二氧化碳排放，并且电动汽车被认为是“气候中性”。 该报告指出，与内燃机汽车相比，纯电动汽车的碳排放量仅“平均减少 41%”，而欧盟法规并未考虑到制造和电力结构等其他因素产生的排放量。 报告得出结论，燃气动力汽车处于劣势，建议排放量应计算在汽车的整个生命周期中，从用于制造汽车的材料到汽车运行的燃料。例如，可以对绿色钢铁的使用或通过回收来回收原材料给予认可。 它强调了支持这种方法的几家主要汽车制造商，包括宝马、奥迪和大众——它们都是慕尼黑工业大学的主要机构捐助者。 乔治·比克 (Georg Bieker) 在美国国际清洁交通委员会 (ICCT) 智囊团研究电动和燃气汽车对环境的影响，他表示慕尼黑工业大学的分析没有提供任何新的见解。他和其他气候和交通专家指出，生命周期评估的重要性已经众所周知。 Bieker 与人共同撰写了一项 2025 年研究，该研究调查了在欧盟销售的乘用车的全球变暖潜力，该研究考虑了从车辆生产到燃料消耗和维护的整个生命周期。研究发现，纯电动汽车的排放量比汽油车平均低 73%，仅使用可再生电力时最高可达 78%。欧盟和国际能源署等机构的类似研究表明，排放量减少了 60%-66%。 德国环境部表示，现代车辆可以...

reflection.en: As debates continue about the environmental impact of electric vehicles, it's a reminder that our stewardship of creation is a profound responsibility. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that the earth and all its fullness belong to Yahweh. This perspective calls us to consider the full lifecycle of our technologies and choices, seeking solutions that honor the...
reflection.zh: 关于电动汽车环境影响的争论仍在继续，这提醒我们，我们对受造界的管理是一项深刻的责任。《诗篇》24:1提醒我们，地和其中所充满的都属于雅伟。这一视角促使我们审视技术和选择的全生命周期，寻求能够荣耀造物主旨意的解决方案。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
title.zh: 王室裂痕：乌干达国王指定电视新闻主播接班人

summary.en: A succession dispute has arisen within Uganda's Tooro Kingdom following the death of King Oyo. While royal elders have named TV presenter Prince Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma as the next monarch, the late king's sister claims he left a will designating his young son as heir.
summary.zh: 乌干达托罗王国在国王奥约去世后爆发了继承权纠纷。尽管王室长老已宣布电视新闻主播爱德华·鲁基迪·基贾南戈马王子为下一任君主，但已故国王的妹妹声称国王留有遗嘱，指定其年幼的儿子为继承人。

body.en:
A bitter succession dispute has erupted in one of Uganda's traditional kingdoms, days before the burial of its late king, who until his death had been the world's youngest reigning monarch.

King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, who ruled the Tooro Kingdom for more than three decades, was undergoing cancer treatment in the US when he died last month aged 34 .

Royal clan elders have named popular TV news presenter Prince Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma, 56, as the next monarch, but this has been rejected by Oyo's close family.

His sister, Princess Ruth Komuntale, said the late king had left a will written in 2022 naming his young son, whose identity has never been disclosed, as his successor.

"My brother did leave behind an heir to the throne, and that was very clearly stated," she said, accusing those behind the announcement on Wednesday night of creating "confusion and turmoil" while the family was still grieving.

Meanwhile the late king's mother, Queen Best Kemigisa, has said royal guards have been withdrawn from the palace and soldiers deployed, restricting the royal family's movement and their ability to receive visitors, describing the situation as "house arrest".

She appealed to the army's leadership and President Yoweri Museveni to allow the family to mourn and bury Oyo in peace on Saturday.

"I appeal to those fighting over the throne: please, there will be time for all of that," she said. "Let us grieve and bury my son King Oyo."

Thousands of mourners are expected to attend the burial at the royal tombs near the palace in Fort Portal in western Uganda.

His body was returned to Uganda from the US on Friday , and preparations for the funeral are under way.

Tooro is one of Uganda's traditional kingdoms. Its monarch has no formal political authority but remains an important cultural figure in western Uganda.

Uganda abolished its traditional kingdoms in 1967, but they were restored in the 1990s under President Museveni. Their monarchs are recognised as cultural leaders rather than political rulers.

The existence of Oyo's son was first publicly revealed in the days after the king's death by President Museveni, who said he had been told about the young boy by the queen mother.

No other details have officially been disclosed, and he had not previously been presented as Oyo's heir.

The disagreement has exposed the complicated way in which succession works in Tooro.

Unlike Britain's monarchy, where the crown passes according to an established line of succession, Tooro's monarch is chosen from the Babiito, the royal dynastic clan.

At a press conference in ​the kingdom's capital of Fort Portal, the royal clan's succession committee announced Kijanangoma, Oyo's cousin and a news presenter ​at the state-run broadcaster UBC, as monarch.

The...
body.zh: 乌干达传统王国之一在其已故国王下葬前几天爆发了一场激烈的继承纠纷，这位国王在去世前一直是世界上最年轻的在位君主。 统治托罗王国三十多年的国王奥约·尼姆巴·卡班巴·伊古鲁·鲁基迪四世上个月在美国接受癌症治疗时去世，享年 34 岁。 王室长老已任命 56 岁的电视新闻节目主持人爱德华·鲁基迪·基贾南戈马 (Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma) 王子为下一任君主，但遭到奥约近亲家族的拒绝。 他的妹妹露丝·科蒙塔莱公主 (Princess Ruth Komuntale) 表示，已故国王在 2022 年留下了一份遗嘱，指定他的小儿子为继承人，但他的身份从未被公开。 “我的兄弟确实留下了一位王位继承人，这一点已经说得非常清楚了，”她说，并指责周三晚上宣布这一消息的人在家人仍然悲伤的时候制造了“混乱和动乱”。 与此同时，已故国王的母亲贝斯特·凯米吉萨王后表示，皇家卫队已从宫殿撤出，并部署了士兵，限制王室成员的行动和接待访客的能力，并将这种情况描述为“软禁”。 她呼吁军队领导层和总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼允许奥约家人于周六哀悼并安葬。 “我向那些争夺王位的人发出呼吁：拜托，所有这些都会有时间，”她说。 “让我们哀悼并埋葬我的儿子奥约国王。” 预计将有数千名哀悼者参加乌干达西部波特尔堡宫殿附近皇家陵墓的葬礼。 他的遗体已于周五从美国运回乌干达，葬礼的准备工作正在进行中。 托罗是乌干达的传统王国之一。它的君主没有正式的政治权力，但仍然是乌干达西部的重要文化人物。 乌干达于 1967 年废除了其传统王国，但在 20 世纪 90 年代穆塞韦尼总统的领导下恢复了这些王国。他们的君主被认为是文化领袖而不是政治统治者。 奥约儿子的存在是在国王去世后几天，总统穆塞韦尼首次公开透露的，他说王太后告诉他这个小男孩的事情。 其他细节尚未正式披露，而且他之前也没有被列为 Oyo 的继承人。 这种分歧暴露了托罗的继承运作方式的复杂性。 与英国的君主制不同，英国的王位按照既定的继承顺序传递，托罗的君主是从皇室家族巴比托中选出的。 在王国首都波特尔堡举行的新闻发布会上，王室继承委员会宣布奥约的表弟、国营广播公司 UBC 的新闻主持人基贾南戈马 (Kijanangoma) 为君主。 这...

reflection.en: The succession dispute in the Tooro Kingdom raises questions about leadership and the well-being of the people. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." May leaders in all realms seek to govern with integrity and care for those they serve.
reflection.zh: 托罗王国继承权的争议引发了关于领导力和民众福祉的问题。耶利米书22:3呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。愿所有领域中的领导者都寻求以正直来治理，并关爱他们所服务的人民。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
title.zh: 中国东部一艘货船起火致25人死亡

summary.en: A fire on a foreign-flagged cargo ship docked in eastern China has killed 25 people. Of the 42 individuals on board, 17 were evacuated, with five requiring hospitalization.
summary.zh: 一艘悬挂外国旗帜的货船在中国东部港口发生火灾，造成25人死亡。船上42人中，有17人被疏散，其中5人正在住院治疗。

body.en:
Twenty-five people have been killed in a fire on a foreign-flagged cargo ship docked at a port in eastern China, according to Chinese state broadcaster CCTV.

Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated of which five are in hospital in stable condition, CCTV reports.

The vessel was undergoing maintenance at a shipyard in the city of Qingdao when the blaze erupted at around 11:15 local time (03:15 GMT). It was put out just over three hours later, according to CCTV.

Photos released by state media showed the vessel to be the Ocean Melody, a 190m (623ft) long Liberia-flagged carrier which arrived in Qingdao on 31 August, according to tracking site MarineTraffic.

It is unclear what caused the fire. An eyewitness told the AFP news agency there was thick smoke rising from the ship, but he heard no explosion.

The country's leader Xi Jinping earlier called for "all-out" search and rescue efforts while Premier Li Qiang stressed the need to "prevent secondary disasters".

The fire comes nearly a month after a shipyard explosion in the south-eastern Chinese province of Fujian killed a rescue worker and injured 12 others.
body.zh: 据中国国家电视台中央电视台报道，一艘停泊在中国东部港口的悬挂外国国旗的货船发生火灾，造成 25 人死亡。 据央视报道，机上42人中，17人已被疏散，其中5人在医院，情况稳定。 当地时间 11 点 15 分（格林威治标准时间 03 点 15 分）左右起火时，该船正在青岛市的一家造船厂进行维护。据中央电视台报道，仅三个多小时后，该消息就被发布了。 据跟踪网站 MarineTraffic 报道，官方媒体发布的照片​​显示，这艘船是 Ocean Melody 号，这是一艘长 190m（623 英尺）、悬挂利比里亚国旗的运输船，于 8 月 31 日抵达青岛。 目前尚不清楚起火原因。一名目击者告诉法新社，船上冒出浓烟，但他没有听到爆炸声。 中国领导人习近平早些时候呼吁“全力以赴”开展搜救工作，而总理李强则强调需要“防止次生灾害”。 火灾发生近一个月前，中国东南部福建省发生造船厂爆炸，造成一名救援人员死亡、十二人受伤。

reflection.en: The news from Qingdao is heartbreaking, reporting 25 lives lost in a sudden fire aboard the cargo ship Ocean Melody. In the face of such profound grief and loss, we turn to the promise that one day all tears will be wiped away, and suffering and death will be no more. May Yahweh bring comfort to the families affected and hope for a future free from such...
reflection.zh: 青岛传来的消息令人心碎，一艘名为“海洋旋律”号的货船突发火灾，夺去了25人的生命。面对如此深切的悲痛和损失，我们转向那应许，终有一天，雅伟要擦去一切眼泪，不再有死亡，也不再有悲伤。愿雅伟赐予受影响的家庭安慰，并带来一个不再有此类悲剧的未来。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Myanmar seeks closer foreign ties amid global isolation
title.zh: 缅甸寻求更紧密的外交关系，但面临全球孤立

summary.en: Myanmar's coup leader, Min Aung Hlaing, has been actively pursuing foreign relations since becoming president in April. However, despite his diplomatic efforts, finding international allies remains a challenge for the isolated nation.
summary.zh: 自4月就任总统以来，缅甸政变领导人敏昂莱一直在积极寻求外交关系。然而，尽管他努力进行外交活动，但对于这个孤立的国家来说，寻找国际盟友仍然是一个挑战。

body.en:
Myanmar coup leader Min Aung Hlaing has been on a diplomatic offensive since becoming president in April, but foreign friends may still be few and far between.

Myanmar coup leader Min Aung Hlaing wrapped up a three-day state visit on Sunday to Vietnam, where the Southeast Asian neighbors vowed to boost defense and security ties.

There was nothing unusual about the trip itself, except that it marked the ex-general's sixth official trip abroad since assuming Myanmar's presidency in April,  when he was voted in by a parliament stacked with loyalists following military-run elections in December and January that were widely considered a charade.

As Myanmar's newly minted head of state, Min Aung Hlaing has been hosted by the leaders of India, China, Laos, Thailand, Russia and now Vietnam — six countries in five months. He'll be heading to Cambodia on Friday to make it seven.

"Since the December-January elections and Min Aung Hlaing's transition to president after giving up his role as commander-in-chief, he's really put a renewed focus on diplomatic partnership and trying to shore up the government's allies in the region,” said Hunter Marston, head of the Southeast Asia Program at the Lowy Institute, a Sydney-based think tank.

"Even if they're relatively short trips to regional friends and allies, I think it shows that there is an acceleration of Naypyitaw's strategy to diversify its partnerships and to normalize relations bilaterally,” he added, referring to Myanmar's capital.

Marston and other analysts told DW that Myanmar is slowly returning to the international stage, aiming to shed its pariah status despite the mountain of war crimes allegations leveled against the regime — some against Min Aung Hlaing himself.

Since Min Aung Hlaing's military toppled the democratically elected government of Nobel laureate Aung San Suu Kyi in 2021, civil war has killed some 100,000 people and displaced over 3 million.

Last month, the United Nations said human rights conditions in the country had sunk to a new low, as the military keeps up a campaign of forced recruitment, arson and often indiscriminate air strikes on contested and resistance-held areas.

That record has also made Myanmar one of the most heavily sanctioned countries in the world and brought on a number of court filings for genocide , war crimes and crimes against humanity at The Hague and elsewhere.

Despite that record, "the military regime is emerging to some extent from its isolation, but engagement is still largely limited to countries that were working with it to some extent prior to the recent sham elections," said Scot Marciel, a senior adviser at the consulting firm BowerGroupAsia.

title.en: How ancient teeth are changing what we know about early drug use
title.zh: 古代牙齿如何改变我们对早期药物使用的认知

summary.en: Scientists suggest that ancient humans may have utilized a nut with psychoactive properties for pain relief, based on new research.
summary.zh: 科学家根据新的研究表明，古代人类可能曾使用一种具有精神活性特性的坚果来缓解疼痛。

body.en:
A study of the teeth of ancient hunter-gatherers shows they sucked on betel nuts, evidence that humans used mind-altering drugs much earlier than previously thought, scientists say.

The Griffith University study, led by Professor Adam Brumm, examined teeth from two skeletons found on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi.

One dated from 16,000 to 25,000 years ago and the other from 6,300 to 7,600 years ago.

Their teeth showed unusual deep and rounded grooves that archaeologists established were caused by previously unknown drug-use behaviour — the habitual sucking of betel nuts, possibly for pain relief.

The betel or areca nut is a palm seed from Southeast Asia and is the fourth most commonly used psychoactive substance in the world, behind alcohol, caffeine and nicotine.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It is mixed with slaked lime powder and chewed to boost its psychoactive properties and create a powerful stimulant.

But adding lime came after the time of the ancient hunter-gatherers, with Brumm saying it's thought they sucked betel nuts for pain relief.

"We think this was a longstanding cultural tradition of drug use that predated the invention of betel nut chewing as we know it today," he told the Australian Associated Press.

"We think this is how humans discovered the mind-altering properties of this particular type of drug."

It was the earliest evidence of the deliberate consumption of a psychoactive plant product but also the earliest evidence of habitual drug use, Brumm said.

Continuous betel-nut sucking wore down the teeth of ancient users, leading to cavities and intense pain, prompting more use of the nut for pain relief in an addictive cycle, he said.

"We can't exclude that they were getting a psychoactive hit but ... we don't think they were cavemen getting high on sucking betel nut."

Over time, ancient people discovered they could make a more potent stimulant if they chewed betel nut mixed with slaked lime, inducing mild euphoria and heightened alertness.

It had been thought the world's first traditions of psychoactive drug use arose after the Neolithic advent of farming, beginning with fermented barley beer about 13,000 years ago in what is now Israel.

The study's findings suggest habitual psychoactive substance use, and its associated health costs, were already present among hunter-gatherers tens of thousands of years before agriculture, Brumm said.

body.zh: 科学家表示，对古代狩猎采集者牙齿的研究表明，他们吸食槟榔，这证明人类使用改变精神药物的时间比之前想象的要早得多。 格里菲斯大学的研究由亚当·布鲁姆教授领导，检查了在印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛发现的两具骨骼中的牙齿。 一个可以追溯到 16,000 至 25,000 年前，另一个可以追溯到 6,300 至 7,600 年前。 他们的牙齿显示出不寻常的深而圆形的凹槽，考古学家确定这些凹槽是由以前未知的吸毒行为引起的——习惯性吮吸槟榔，可能是为了缓解疼痛。 槟榔或槟榔是来自东南亚的棕榈种子，是世界上第四大最常用的精神活性物质，仅次于酒精、咖啡因和尼古丁。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 将其与熟石灰粉混合并咀嚼可增强其精神活性并产生强大的兴奋剂。 但添加石灰是在古代狩猎采集时代之后出现的，布鲁姆说，人们认为他们吸槟榔是为了缓解疼痛。 “我们认为这是一种长期存在的吸毒文化传统，早于我们今天所知的咀嚼槟榔的发明，”他告诉澳大利亚美联社。 “我们认为这就是人类发现这种特殊药物的改变精神特性的方式。” 布鲁姆说，这是故意食用精神活性植物产品的最早证据，也是习惯性吸毒的最早证据。 他说，连续吸食槟榔会磨损古代使用者的牙齿，导致蛀牙和剧烈疼痛，促使人们更多地使用槟榔来缓解疼痛，形成成瘾循环。 “我们不能排除他们受到了精神上的打击，但是……我们不认为他们是因为吸食槟榔而兴奋的穴居人。” 随着时间的推移，古人发现，如果咀嚼槟榔和熟石灰混合，可以产生一种更有效的兴奋剂，引起轻微的欣快感和高度的警觉性。 人们认为，世界上第一个使用精神药物的传统是在新石器时代农业出现之后出现的，始于大约 13,000 年前在现在的以色列的发酵大麦啤酒。 布鲁姆说，这项研究的结果表明，在农业出现之前数万年，狩猎采集者就已经存在习惯性精神活性物质的使用及其相关的健康成本。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: Donald Trump's 'only condition' for $5,000 payments to every American
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普向每位美国人支付5000美元的“唯一条件”

summary.en: President Donald Trump has pledged to pay every adult American $5,000 if Republicans maintain control of Congress in the upcoming midterm elections. This "Trump dividend" proposal, which could cost over $1.35 trillion, has raised questions about its funding source, which the president has not specified.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普承诺，如果共和党在即将到来的中期选举中继续控制国会，将向每位成年美国人支付5000美元。这项“特朗普红利”的提议可能耗资超过1.35万亿美元，但总统尚未明确其资金来源，引发了相关疑问。

body.en:
President Donald Trump said on Thursday he would pay every US adult a US$5,000 ($6,926) "Trump dividend" if Republicans retain control of Congress in November's midterm election, an extraordinary attempt to persuade voters to back his party.

"If the Republicans win, you win with us, and you get $5,000. It will be called the Trump dividend," he told the Republican midterm convention audience in Dallas, Texas.

Trump likened the payments to a corporation's distributions to shareholders, citing "our tremendous strength and success economically".

He did not say where the money would come from — with the theoretical bill likely topping US$1.35 trillion ($1.85 trillion) — citing only that "our country is making so much money".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The promise would require congressional approval, and would further exacerbate the country’s nearly US$1.8 trillion annual budget deficit and concerns about inflation.

The payment would also come with a catch — Trump was clear he only wanted US citizens spending their prospective windfalls at home.

"But the only condition on the payment of this dividend that we’re going to be making … is that it must be spent in the United States of America," Trump told the convention crowd.

"We don’t want you going to Canada to spend the money. We don't want you going to China, to Germany. We got to spend the money in the United States of America."

Trump did not say how he and his administration would ensure the funds were only spent in the US.

During a primetime address that lasted an hour and 45 minutes, Trump boasted of completing "the greatest two years in the history of the presidency", putting himself squarely at the centre of the election despite his deepening unpopularity.

But it was not clear whether his campaign-style speech would appeal to the critical swing voters who opinion polls show have drifted away from Trump's party, amid growing dissatisfaction with the cost of living and the war on Iran.

"We hand America's future to the radical left Democrats, and our nation will spend the next decade just getting back on its feet," he said. "Vote Republicans, and we will leave the world in our dust for generations to come."

Within an hour, vice president JD Vance appeared to try to walk back Trump’s proposal — at least in part — by suggesting the dividend payments would not go to the wealthy. Vance suggested it could be paid for by US tariff revenues , though the suggested payment dwarfs what the US has taken in through the protectionist measures.

title.en: Why Donald Trump's latest map has the North Atlantic on edge
title.zh: 特朗普的最新地图为何让北大西洋紧张起来

summary.en: A map posted by United States President Donald Trump, showing the US extending to include Greenland and Iceland, has drawn sharp reactions from North Atlantic governments. The president offered no explanation for the 'disturbing' post, which follows months of comments about potentially annexing Canada and acquiring...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普发布的一张地图，显示美国领土延伸至格陵兰岛和冰岛，引起了北大西洋各国政府的强烈反应。总统未对此“令人不安”的帖子作出任何解释，此前他已就可能吞并加拿大和出于战略原因获取格陵兰岛发表了数月评论。

body.en:
A map posted by United States President Donald Trump has drawn sharp reactions from governments across the North Atlantic.

The image showed the US stretching across North America and extending north to include Greenland and Iceland.

But it came after months of comments about Canada becoming the 51st US state and repeated statements about taking control of Greenland, a self-governing territory within the Kingdom of Denmark.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Trump has repeatedly said the US should acquire Greenland, citing its strategic importance.

Greenland is geographically part of North America but politically linked to Europe through its relationship with Denmark. It has extensive self-government, while Denmark remains responsible for areas including foreign and defence policy.

The latest map prompted a strong response from Danish foreign minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen.

"It’s disturbing and, in many ways, completely inappropriate," he told Danish broadcaster DR on Wednesday.

He said the post showed that Trump still held what he described as a "maximalist vision" and added: "We need to rein that in."

Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen also stressed that Greenlanders had repeatedly said they did not want to become part of the US.

Iceland became part of the controversy after Trump repeatedly referred to Iceland instead of Greenland while discussing his plans.

The countries are relatively close geographically, with Iceland about 290km from Greenland, but Iceland is an independent country and a NATO member.

Iceland's foreign secretary Thorgerdur Katrín Gunnarsdóttir summoned US ambassador Billy Long after Trump's map was posted. According to Iceland's national broadcaster RÚV, she told him the post was unacceptable.

The controversy has also added to debate in Iceland over its relationship with Europe.

Its left-leaning coalition government put forward a referendum on whether to resume long-stalled EU membership negotiations, partly framed around strengthening ties with Europe amid geopolitical uncertainty.

Earlier this year, thousands of Icelanders signed a petition urging the government to reject him as ambassador after he joked about Iceland becoming the 52nd US state and himself becoming its governor.

His comments came as Trump was already drawing attention in the region with his repeated statements about Greenland and Canada.

Canada has also faced frequent comments from Trump about becoming part of the US.

The remarks have coincided with a trade war between Washington and Ottawa. Trump has also recently referred to Lake Ontario as "Lake America".

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普发布的一张地图引起了北大西洋各国政府的强烈反应。 该图像显示美国横跨北美并向北延伸包括格陵兰岛和冰岛。 但此前几个月，有关加拿大成为美国第 51 个州的言论不断涌现，并多次声明要控制丹麦王国境内的自治领土格陵兰岛。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 特朗普多次表示，美国应该收购格陵兰岛，理由是其战略重要性。 格陵兰岛在地理上是北美的一部分，但在政治上通过与丹麦的关系与欧洲联系在一起。它拥有广泛的自治权，而丹麦仍然负责外交和国防政策等领域。 最新的地图引起了丹麦外交部长拉斯·洛克·拉斯穆森的强烈反应。 “这令人不安，而且在很多方面都是完全不合适的，”他周三告诉丹麦广播公司 DR。 他说，这篇帖子表明特朗普仍然持有他所说的“极简主义愿景”，并补充说：“我们需要控制这一点。” 丹麦首相梅特·弗雷德里克森也强调，格陵兰人曾多次表示，他们不想成为美国的一部分。 特朗普在讨论他的计划时多次提到冰岛而不是格陵兰岛后，冰岛成为争议的一部分。 两国地理位置较为接近，冰岛距离格陵兰岛约290公里，但冰岛是独立国家，也是北约成员国。 在特朗普的地图发布后，冰岛外交大臣索尔格杜尔·卡特林·古纳尔斯多蒂尔召见了美国大使比利·朗。据冰岛国家广播公司 RÚV 报道，她告诉他这个帖子是不可接受的。 这场争议也加剧了冰岛关于其与欧洲关系的争论。 其左倾联合政府就是否恢复长期停滞的欧盟成员资格谈判提出了公投，部分目的是在地缘政治不确定性的情况下加强与欧洲的关系。 今年早些时候，数千名冰岛人签署了一份请愿书，敦促政府拒绝他担任大使，因为他开玩笑说冰岛将成为美国第 52 个州，而他自己也将成为该州州长。 在他发表此番言论之际，特朗普多次就格陵兰岛和加拿大发表言论，已经引起了该地区的关注。 加拿大也经常面临特朗普关于成为美国一部分的评论。 此番言论恰逢华盛顿和渥太华之间的贸易战。特朗普最近还将安大略湖称为“美国湖”。 在他的北美地图的同一个周末......

reflection.en: The posting of a map that dramatically redraws national boundaries, without explanation, can stir anxieties and challenge established international relations. Such actions can be seen as a manifestation of pride or overreach, reminding us that "pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall."
reflection.zh: 一张未经解释就大幅重绘国家边界的地图的发布，可能会引发焦虑并挑战既有的国际关系。此类行为可被视为骄傲或越权的体现，提醒我们“骄傲在灭亡之前，狂心在跌倒之前。”

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

title.en: China Desk

title.en: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
title.zh: 中国东部货船火灾致二十五人死亡

summary.en: Twenty-five people have died after a fire broke out on a cargo ship docked in eastern China. Of the 42 individuals on board, 17 were rescued, with five requiring hospitalization.
summary.zh: 中国东部一艘货船发生火灾，造成二十五人死亡。船上共有四十二人，其中十七人获救，五人需住院治疗。

body.en:
Twenty-five people have been killed in a fire on a foreign-flagged cargo ship docked at a port in eastern China, according to Chinese state broadcaster CCTV.

Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated of which five are in hospital in stable condition, CCTV reports.

The vessel was undergoing maintenance at a shipyard in the city of Qingdao when the blaze erupted at around 11:15 local time (03:15 GMT). It was put out just over three hours later, according to CCTV.

Photos released by state media showed the vessel to be the Ocean Melody, a 190m (623ft) long Liberia-flagged carrier which arrived in Qingdao on 31 August, according to tracking site MarineTraffic.

It is unclear what caused the fire. An eyewitness told the AFP news agency there was thick smoke rising from the ship, but he heard no explosion.

The country's leader Xi Jinping earlier called for "all-out" search and rescue efforts while Premier Li Qiang stressed the need to "prevent secondary disasters".

The fire comes nearly a month after a shipyard explosion in the south-eastern Chinese province of Fujian killed a rescue worker and injured 12 others.
body.zh: 据中国国家电视台中央电视台报道，一艘停泊在中国东部港口的悬挂外国国旗的货船发生火灾，造成 25 人死亡。 据央视报道，机上42人中，17人已被疏散，其中5人在医院，情况稳定。 当地时间 11 点 15 分（格林威治标准时间 03 点 15 分）左右起火时，该船正在青岛市的一家造船厂进行维护。据中央电视台报道，仅三个多小时后，该消息就被发布了。 据跟踪网站 MarineTraffic 报道，官方媒体发布的照片​​显示，这艘船是 Ocean Melody 号，这是一艘长 190m（623 英尺）、悬挂利比里亚国旗的运输船，于 8 月 31 日抵达青岛。 目前尚不清楚起火原因。一名目击者告诉法新社，船上冒出浓烟，但他没有听到爆炸声。 中国领导人习近平早些时候呼吁“全力以赴”开展搜救工作，而总理李强则强调需要“防止次生灾害”。 火灾发生近一个月前，中国东南部福建省发生造船厂爆炸，造成一名救援人员死亡、十二人受伤。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of 25 lives in the Qingdao port fire is a stark reminder of the fragility of life and the deep sorrow that such events bring. In a world marked by suffering and death, we hold onto the promise of a future where such pain will cease.
reflection.zh: 青岛港货船火灾造成25人死亡的悲剧，令人痛心地认识到生命的脆弱和事件带来的深切悲伤。在这个充满苦难和死亡的世界里，我们怀抱一个应许，那时的痛苦将不再有。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: China: Cargo ship fire kills at least 25
title.zh: 中国：货船火灾致至少25人死亡

summary.en: At least 25 people were killed and five remain missing after a fire on a cargo vessel receiving repairs at a shipyard in the northeastern Chinese port city of Qingdao, state media reported on Thursday. The vessel, identified as the "Ocean Melody," caught fire around 11:15 a.m. local time and the blaze was extinguished...
summary.zh: 据国家媒体周四报道，在中国东北部港口城市青岛的一家造船厂，一艘正在接受维修的货船发生火灾，造成至少25人死亡，另有5人失踪。该船被确认为“海洋旋律”号，于当地时间上午11:15左右起火，大火于下午2:30左右被扑灭。

body.zh: 一艘货船在青岛港起火，造成至少五人失踪。原因尚不清楚。 据官方媒体周四报道，中国东北港口城市青岛一家造船厂一艘正在维修的货船发生火灾，造成至少 25 人死亡，5 人失踪。 据国家电视台中央电视台报道，这艘载有 42 人的船只于当地时间上午 11 点 15 分左右起火，并于下午 2 点 30 分左右被扑灭。 （世界标准时间 0630）。” 据官方通讯社新华社报道，这艘船被确定为长 190 米（623 英尺）的散货船“Ocean Melody”，悬挂利比里亚国旗。 新华社补充说，中国国家主席习近平发布了开展搜救任务的“重要指示”，同时还呼吁对可能对此次事件负责的任何人进行调查。 习近平表示，“各地区、各有关部门要深刻汲取此次事件教训，彻查整顿各类火灾隐患”。 该船当时正在青岛北海造船有限公司进行维修，该公司隶属于中国船舶工业集团公司（CSSC），是世界上最大的造船厂之一。

reflection.en: The news from Qingdao is heartbreaking, detailing the loss of life in a sudden, devastating fire. In moments of profound tragedy, when grief feels overwhelming, we hold onto the promise that Yahweh will one day wipe away every tear. Until that day, may comfort be found in shared sorrow and the hope of ultimate restoration.
reflection.zh: 青岛传来的消息令人心碎，详细描述了一场突如其来的毁灭性火灾造成的生命损失。在如此深切的悲剧中，当悲伤似乎难以承受时，我们紧握着雅伟终将擦去一切眼泪的应许。直到那一天，愿在共同的哀伤和最终复原的盼望中找到安慰。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with our God.' This principle applies not only to our personal lives but also to our professional conduct and our engagement with the wider world, especially when faced...
reflection.zh: 亚历山大·切尔戈被判刑的消息，警示我们所有交往都必须秉持诚信。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行”。这一原则不仅适用于我们的个人生活，也适用于我们的职业操守以及与世界的互动，尤其是在面对可能损害我们道德标准的机会时。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role

The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...

The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国结束英语核心地位的呼吁引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI. The debate highlights the tension between traditional academic priorities and the perceived needs of a rapidly evolving, technologically advanced society.
summary.zh: 在中国，一项旨在降低英语在中国学校核心地位的呼吁，正引发关于英语对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。这场辩论凸显了传统学术优先事项与一个快速发展、技术先进的社会之需求之间的紧张关系。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of knowledge, particularly in fields like AI, presents both opportunities and challenges. As China debates the role of English in its education system, it grapples with how best to equip its students for a future where information and communication are constantly evolving. This reflects Daniel's prophecy of knowledge increasing,...
reflection.zh: 知识的快速增长，尤其是在人工智能等领域，既带来了机遇也带来了挑战。中国在辩论英语在其教育体系中的作用时，正努力思考如何最好地为学生在一个信息和沟通不断发展的未来做好准备。这呼应了但以理关于知识增长的预言，敦促我们在获取信息的同时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

The European Commission has proposed a significant overhaul of EU public procurement rules, aiming to boost European...
summary.zh: 作为欧盟最新对抗中国经济实力的举措的一部分，欧洲当局和公共机构在花费公共资金时将被鼓励购买更多国内商品和服务。欧盟委员会已提议对欧盟公共采购规则进行重大改革，旨在提振欧洲产业。

body.en: Authorities and public bodies to be urged to buy goods and services from Europe, but without binding quotas European authorities will be encouraged to buy more domestic goods and services when they spend public money under the EU latest effort to counter China’s economic might. In a further “Buy European” plan, the European Commission published proposals on Wednesday for a sweeping overhaul of EU public procurement rules. Continue reading...
body.zh: 敦促当局和公共机构从欧洲购买商品和服务，但没有约束性配额。根据欧盟对抗中国经济实力的最新举措，欧洲当局在花费公共资金时将被鼓励购买更多国内商品和服务。在进一步的“购买欧洲”计划中，欧盟委员会周三公布了对欧盟公共采购规则进行全面改革的提案。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often seek to bolster their own economies through trade policies. The EU's new 'Buy European' initiative aims to strengthen domestic industries by directing public spending towards European goods and services. This highlights the complex interplay of national economies and the desire for self-sufficiency, a dynamic that calls for wisdom and fairness...
reflection.zh: 各国常常试图通过贸易政策来支撑本国经济。欧盟新的“购买欧洲”倡议旨在通过将公共支出导向欧洲商品和服务来加强国内产业。这凸显了国家经济之间复杂的相互作用，以及对自给自足的渴望，这种动态呼吁在所有交易中都要有智慧和公平。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Yuja review – portrait of star pianist who is intellectually curious and deeply musically attuned
title.zh: Yuja乐评——这位求知欲强、音乐造诣深厚的钢琴家画像

summary.en: Musician is also rattled to find her appearance gets far more attention than her playing in this reflective documentary from Lorna Tucker As well as her film about her own difficult teenage years, British director Lorna Tucker is probably best known for her documentaries on famous women with big personalities:...
summary.zh: 在这部由洛娜·塔克执导的反思性纪录片中，音乐家发现自己的外表比演奏更受关注，这让她感到不安。除了她关于自己艰难青少年时期的电影外，英国导演洛娜·塔克可能最出名的是她拍摄的关于个性鲜明的名人的纪录片：薇薇恩·韦斯特伍德（ Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist ）、凯瑟琳·赫本（ Call Me...

body.en: Musician is also rattled to find her appearance gets far more attention than her playing in this reflective documentary from Lorna Tucker As well as her film about her own difficult teenage years , British director Lorna Tucker is probably best known for her documentaries on famous women with big personalities: Vivienne Westwood ( Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist ), Katharine Hepburn (Call Me Kate) and Greta Garbo ( Garbo: Where Did You Go? ). Her latest subject, pianist Yuja Wang, is another high-achiever – but not someone with quite the same name recognition unless you’re a devotee of classical music, a field in which she is ranked among the very best alive. Wang certainly has a flamboyant side, expressed in her highly expressive, virtuoso performances and her sartorial style on stage. In fact some shocking pull quotes illustrate how her dress sense has been bizarrely over-examined in the press; she has been likened to a stripper for her outfits, and the New Yorker, of all publications, once described her as “fat” , which hardly seems germane to any discussion of her ability to play Tchaikovsky or Ligeti. But Wang’s biography and the texture of her daily life are very different from that of Tucker’s previous subjects. She was a child prodigy from an artistic Beijing family who came of age just in time to break records for views on YouTube. Sure, her life here looks glamorous in one way, with a lush New York apartment she barely ever sees because she’s constantly on the road. But her life is also one of perpetual practice and striving for perfection, the loneliness of the long-distance soloist. It’s a regimen that leaves almost no time for relationships or family, or even many friendships with peers who understand what she is going through – apart from a few mentors or collaborators such as fellow pianist Emanuel Ax or composer Teddy Abrams, with whom she recently won a Grammy. Still, she comes across as an effervescent character, intellectually curious and deeply attuned to the music she plays. Continue reading...
body.zh: 音乐家还惊讶地发现，在洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 的这部反思性纪录片中，她的外表比她的演奏受到更多关注。除了她关于自己艰难的青少年时期的电影外，英国导演洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 最出名的可能是她关于具有大个性的著名女性的纪录片：维维安·韦斯特伍德 (维维安·韦斯特伍德) (韦斯特伍德：朋克、偶像、激进分子)、凯瑟琳·赫本 (叫我凯特) 和葛丽泰·嘉宝 (嘉宝：你去哪儿了？)。她最新的对象钢琴家王羽佳是另一位成就斐然的人，但除非你是古典音乐的爱好者，否则她的知名度不会很高，而她在古典音乐领域被列为当今最优秀的音乐爱好者之一。王确实有华丽的一面，这体现在她极具表现力、精湛的表演和舞台上的服装风格上。事实上，一些令人震惊的引述说明了媒体如何奇怪地过度审视了她的着装品味。她因服装而被比作脱衣舞娘，所有出版物中的《纽约客》曾将她描述为“胖子”，这似乎与她扮演柴可夫斯基或利盖蒂的能力的任何讨论都没有关系。但王的传记和她的日常生活质感与塔克之前的主题有很大不同。她是来自北京一个艺术家庭的神童，成年后正好打破了 YouTube 上的观看次数记录。当然，她在这里的生活在某种程度上看起来很迷人，她几乎从未见过纽约的一套豪华公寓，因为她经常在路上。但她的生活也是一种不断练习和追求完美的生活，一种长距离独奏者的孤独。这种生活方式几乎没有时间留给人际关系或家庭，甚至没有时间与理解她正在经历的事情的同龄人建立友谊——除了一些导师或合作者，比如钢琴家伊曼纽尔·阿克斯(Emanuel Ax)或作曲家泰迪·艾布拉姆斯(Teddy Abrams)，她最近与他们一起赢得了格莱美奖。尽管如此，她仍然给人一种热情洋溢的感觉，求知欲强，对她演奏的音乐有着深刻的理解。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary offers a glimpse into the life of pianist Yuja Wang, showcasing her intense dedication and intellectual curiosity in the demanding world of classical music. Her commitment to mastering her art, even when facing external distractions like undue attention to her appearance, speaks to a deep-seated passion for her calling. Colossians 3:23...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片让我们得以一窥钢琴家王羽佳的生活，展现了她在古典音乐这个要求严苛的领域中，她那份强烈的奉献精神和求知欲。即使面对外表受到不当关注等外部干扰，她仍致力于精进技艺，这体现了她对自己使命的深切热情。 歌罗西书 3:23 提醒我们：“无论做什么，都要从心里去做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的。”...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: How Mao Zedong's legacy still shapes China 50 years on
title.zh: 毛泽东的遗产如何至今仍在塑造中国

summary.en: Fifty years after Mao Zedong's death, China has undergone significant transformation. However, his legacy persists, influencing current leadership under Xi Jinping and fueling a resurgence of Maoist nostalgia among younger generations.
summary.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十年来，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。然而，他的遗产依然存在，影响着习近平领导下的当今政权，并在年轻一代中引发了对毛泽东时代的新怀旧潮。

body.en:
China has transformed since Mao Zedong's death 50 years ago. But his legacy endures — from Xi Jinping's rule to a new wave of Mao nostalgia among young Chinese.

On September 9, 1976, Mao Zedong died. The revolutionary leader who led the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to power and founded the People's Republic of China left behind a profoundly contradictory historical legacy.

He shaped the narratives of revolution, nation-building and national independence, but also left behind immense social trauma as a result of successive political campaigns and persecutions.

When Mao died, China was still a poor and relatively isolated communist state. Today, it is the world's second-largest economy, deeply embedded in the supply and value chains of global capitalism, with a vast private sector, a large urban middle class and a highly digitalized society. 

Zhang Lun, a professor at Cergy-Paris University, said Mao left behind four major political legacies: the authoritarian and highly centralized political system; a model of governance that relies on revolution and political campaigns to solve social problems; populist tendencies marked by anti-elitism and anti-rationalism; and utopian visions of egalitarianism and moralism.

From the perspective of political legacies, Zhang told DW, the most fundamental change in China over the past five decades has been "de-Maoization" — while its greatest challenge has been that this process was never fully completed.

Mao's name remains written into the CCP's constitution, while his thought remains part of China's official ideology and his portrait still hangs in Beijing's Tiananmen Square.

Mao helped forge the Chinese Communist Party, and his insistence on the party's supremacy over the state and society has remained a fundamental principle throughout the decades, said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt, professor at the University of Zurich.

Veteran journalist and political commentator Chang Ping agrees, adding that what has truly endured is the institutional core of the principle that "the party leads everything," serving a state vision of being able to "concentrate resources to accomplish major tasks." 

The CCP, he said, can pursue such objectives "at all costs" — meaning the interests of ordinary people can be sacrificed to the maximum extent necessary to preserve the regime. 

Under current leader Xi Jinping , a number of political concepts and methods of governance associated with the Mao era — such as ideological unity and the spirit of "struggle" — have again attracted attention.

Xi's actions such as abolishing the presidential term limits, strengthening his personal authority and the incorporation of his political...
body.zh: 毛泽东逝世50年来，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。但他的遗产依然存在——从习近平的统治到中国年轻人新一轮的毛泽东怀旧浪潮。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强他的个人权威以及纳入他的政治...

reflection.en: Mao Zedong's death 50 years ago marked a turning point for China, yet his ideological and political shadow continues to shape the nation. This enduring influence, from state narratives to popular nostalgia, speaks to the profound and often complex impact of historical figures. The story prompts reflection on how legacies, whether positive or negative, can...
reflection.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十周年标志着中国的一个转折点，但他的意识形态和政治影响至今仍在塑造着这个国家。这种从国家叙事到大众怀旧的持久影响，体现了历史人物深刻而复杂的作用。这个故事促使我们反思，无论正面还是负面，遗产如何能够持续并塑造现在，并提醒我们，不受约束的权力和野心可能带来长远甚至意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed many lives and left others missing, the news of a found Australian offers a beacon of hope. This story echoes the Psalmist's declaration that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For the families who feared the worst, this reunion is a profound answer to prayer and a testament to...
reflection.zh: 在夺走许多生命并导致多人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个故事呼应了诗篇作者的宣告：哭泣虽可过夜，但早晨必带来欢欣。对于那些曾恐惧最坏情况的家庭来说，这次重逢是对祷告的深刻回应，也是坚韧不拔的证明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: How the Nepal-Tibet disaster became the latest victim of China’s ‘Clean Internet’ campaign
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏灾难如何成为中国“净网”运动的最新牺牲品

Tsering Phuntsok watched news of the Nepal-Tibet flood unfold from thousands of miles away in southern India. The 46-year-old Tibetan in exile has missing...
