title.en: Fossil flowers of ancient lianas preserved in amber reveal the evolution of tropical rainforests
title.zh: 琥珀中保存的古代藤本植物化石揭示了热带雨林的演化

summary.en: Tiny flowers trapped in amber around 15 million years ago are offering scientists a rare glimpse into the plant life of a tropical rainforest in what is now Southeast China. Researchers have studied two exceptionally well-preserved fossil flowers from the Zhangpu flora, finding that lianas played an important role in...
summary.zh: 大约1500万年前被琥珀包裹的微小花朵，让科学家们得以一窥如今中国东南地区热带雨林的植物生命。研究人员研究了来自漳浦植物群的两朵保存极其完好的化石花朵，发现藤本植物在中新世中期已在热带森林的植被结构中扮演重要角色。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Tiny flowers trapped in amber around 15 million years ago are offering scientists a rare glimpse into the plant life of a tropical rainforest in what is now Southeast China. Researchers have studied two exceptionally well-preserved fossil flowers from the Zhangpu flora.

Their findings, published in the journal Annals of Botany , show that lianas already played an important role in the vegetation structure of tropical forests during the Middle Miocene.

"The fossils show not only that this plant group existed in Southeast China 15 million years ago," says Eva-Maria Sadowski from the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin. "They also connect a Miocene plant lineage with its living relatives. This provides important insights into how plants evolved and how past ecosystems were composed."

The fossils belong to the genus Ayenia (section Vahihara) in the mallow family (Malvaceae). One of the flowers is described as a new fossil species, Ayenia zhangpuensis, while the second specimen is assigned informally to Ayenia sp.

Using light microscopy and X-ray tomography, the researchers were able to examine the delicate floral structures in detail.

"The exceptional preservation of these flowers allows us to identify features that are rarely preserved in fossil plants," says Gongle Shi of the Nanjing Institute of Geology and Paleontology in China. "Their similarity to living Ayenia species shows that the basic floral structure of this lineage has remained remarkably stable since at least the Middle Miocene."

The Zhangpu flora from Fujian Province in Southeast China provides one of the most important windows into a tropical ecosystem of the Middle Miocene. During a period of globally warm climate, the region supported a highly diverse rainforest. Amber fossils from this period preserve numerous plants and animals in exceptional detail.

However, climbing plants are particularly difficult to identify in the fossil record. Their delicate structures often decay before they can be preserved under favorable conditions. As a result, their role in ancient forest ecosystems is often underestimated. The newly described flowers therefore add an important piece to the picture of the Zhangpu flora.

The discovery is more than a snapshot of a past rainforest. The close similarity between the fossil and living Ayenia flowers points to long-term continuity in floral form. At the same time, the fossils demonstrate how amber can help scientists reconstruct the evolutionary history of plants and the composition of ecosystems over millions of years.

Xieting Wu et al, Fossil flowers of Ayenia (Malvaceae)...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 大约1500万年前被困在琥珀中的微小花朵让科学家们得以难得一睹现在中国东南部热带雨林的植物生命。研究人员研究了漳浦植物区系中两种保存异常完好的花化石。 他们的研究结果发表在《植物学年鉴》杂志上，表明藤本植物在中中新世期间已经在热带森林的植被结构中发挥了重要作用。 柏林自然博物馆的伊娃-玛丽亚·萨多斯基 (Eva-Maria Sadowski) 表示：“这些化石不仅表明这一植物群在 1500 万年前就存在于中国东南部。” “它们还将中新世植物谱系与其现存的近亲联系起来。这为了解植物如何进化以及过去的生态系统如何组成提供了重要的见解。” 这些化石属于锦葵科（锦葵科）的 Ayenia 属（Vahihara 组）。其中一朵花被描述为新的化石物种，Ayenia zhangpuensis，而第二个标本被非正式地指定为 Ayenia sp。 利用光学显微镜和 X 射线断层扫描，研究人员能够详细检查精致的花卉结构。 中国南京地质古生物研究所的石公乐说：“这些花朵的特殊保存使我们能够识别植物化石中很少保存的特征。” “它们与现存的艾叶尼亚物种的相似性表明，至少自中新世中期以来，该谱系的基本花卉结构一直保持着非常稳定的状态。” 中国东南部福建省的漳浦植物群是了解中中新世热带生态系统最重要的窗口之一。在全球气候温暖的时期，该地区拥有高度多样化的雨林。这一时期的琥珀化石保存了许多动植物的细节。 然而，攀缘植物在化石记录中特别难以识别。它们脆弱的结构在能够在有利的条件下保存之前经常会腐烂。因此，它们在古代森林生态系统中的作用常常被低估。因此，新描述的花朵为漳浦植物区系的图景增添了重要的一环。 这一发现不仅仅是过去雨林的一个快照。化石和现存的艾叶尼亚花之间的密切相似性表明了花形的长期连续性。同时，这些化石展示了琥珀如何帮助科学家重建数百万年来植物的进化历史和生态系统的组成。 Xieting Wu 等人，Ayenia（锦葵科）的化石花...

reflection.en: The discovery of ancient liana flowers preserved in amber offers a tangible link to Earth's past ecosystems. It reminds us that the natural world, even in its fossilized remnants, holds profound lessons about the history and complexity of life. Yahweh's creation continues to reveal its intricate design and history to those who observe it with diligence and...
reflection.zh: 在琥珀中发现保存完好的古代藤本植物花朵，为我们提供了与地球古代生态系统之间的有形联系。它提醒我们，自然界，即使是其化石遗迹，也蕴含着关于生命历史和复杂性的深刻教训。雅伟的创造继续向那些勤奋而惊奇地观察它的人们揭示其精妙的设计和历史。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Report maps pathways for accelerating environmental solutions through positive tipping points
title.zh: 报告绘制了通过积极的临界点加速环境解决方案的途径

summary.en: New research from The Earthshot Prize and the University of Exeter's Green Futures Solutions team, published today, reveals 51 environmental solutions that can trigger rapid, transformative change to repair our planet within the next five years. After a northern summer of extreme heat and fire, and as the world...
summary.zh: 今天公布的“地球奖”和埃克塞特大学绿色未来解决方案团队的最新研究揭示了51项环境解决方案，这些方案可以在未来五年内触发快速、变革性的变化，以修复我们的地球。在经历了创纪录的北半球夏季高温和火灾，以及世界正为前所未有的厄尔尼诺现象做准备之际，这项研究为积极行动提供了一个新的、统一的议程。

body.en: New research from The Earthshot Prize and the University of Exeter's Green Futures Solutions team, published today, reveals 51 environmental solutions that can trigger rapid, transformative change to repair our planet within the next five years. After a northern summer of extreme heat and fire, and as the world prepares for an unprecedented El Niño, the research provides a new, unifying agenda for positive action.
body.zh: 今天发布的 Earthshot 奖和埃克塞特大学绿色未来解决方案团队的新研究揭示了 51 种环境解决方案，这些解决方案可以在未来五年内引发快速、变革性的变革来修复我们的星球。在经历了北方夏季的酷热和火灾之后，当世界为前所未有的厄尔尼诺现象做准备时，这项研究为积极行动提供了一个新的、统一的议程。

reflection.en: Amidst a summer of extreme heat and fire, this research offers a hopeful agenda for planetary repair. It reminds us that the Earth, with all its systems, is ultimately Yahweh's, and we are called to be faithful stewards of His creation. May this work inspire collective action towards healing our world.
reflection.zh: 在经历了创纪录的高温和火灾的夏季之后，这项研究为修复地球提供了一个充满希望的议程。它提醒我们，地球及其万物最终都属于雅伟，而我们被呼召成为祂创造物忠实的管家。愿这项工作能激励我们采取集体行动，治愈我们的世界。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Indonesia rescues six orangutans from fires in a week
title.zh: 印尼一周内救出六只猩猩

summary.en: Indonesian authorities and rescuers reported saving six orangutans, including two nursing infants, from ongoing fires on Borneo in the past week. This brings the total number of orangutans rescued in the last month to 15. The apes were found stranded in plantations in West Kalimantan after fires blocked their access...
summary.zh: 印尼当局和救援人员周四表示，过去一周内，在婆罗洲的持续大火中，他们已救出六只猩猩，其中包括两只哺乳期的幼崽。这使得上个月获救的猩猩总数达到15只。这些猿猴是在印尼西加里曼丹省的种植园中被救出的，当时大火切断了它们返回森林家园的通道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Six orangutans, including two nursing infants, have been rescued from fires raging on Borneo in the past week, Indonesian authorities and rescuers said Thursday, bringing the total to 15 in a month.

The apes were saved from plantations in rural West Kalimantan province, on the Indonesian part of the island, where they got stuck after fires cut off access to their forest home, according to the forestry ministry and the YIARI wildlife rehabilitation foundation.

A large fire was burning just 200 meters (656 feet) from where the group of critically endangered primates was found, the ministry and YIARI said in a joint statement.

"This situation left the orangutans without a safe route back to their habitat; they could only move from one plantation to another," said the statement.

"In addition to facing the threat of flames and smoke, the orangutans' movement among plantations also has the potential to increase interactions and conflict with (human) communities."

Four orangutans were rescued Friday with the help of residents and plantation workers, followed by another mother-infant pair Tuesday.

Rescuers had to anesthetize the animals to minimize stress and the risk of injury. All six were taken to YIARI's rehabilitation center in the town of Ketapang.

Orangutans are endemic to the islands of Borneo and Sumatra—two of the places hardest hit by wildfires that have destroyed vast swaths of land and spewed putrid haze that has spread as far as Malaysia and Singapore.

The Indonesian government said more than 202,000 hectares of land burned countrywide between January and July. Figures for August have yet to be released.

The Nusantara Atlas project has put the number closer to 300,000 hectares and on Thursday estimated 895,657 hectares, including August.

Last week, the European Union's Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service said the haze emitted by the fires was the worst for any August in 24 years.

Indonesia's dry season typically runs from July to October, made worse this year by a strong episode of the El Niño weather phenomenon.

Wildfires emit dangerous levels of PM2.5 particles , which are so small they can enter deep into the lungs and even the bloodstream, with potentially dire health consequences.

According to Greenpeace estimates using government data, some 35 million people in Indonesia are exposed to toxic haze.

Some 43,000 firefighters were deployed to combat the blazes, national disaster mitigation agency spokesman Berton Panjaitan told reporters in Jakarta on Thursday.

He said a Japanese navy ship had arrived in West Kalimantan with three helicopters...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 印度尼西亚当局和救援人员周四表示，过去一周，已有六只猩猩从婆罗洲肆虐的大火中获救，其中包括两只正在哺乳的婴儿，使一个月内的猩猩总数达到 15 只。 据林业部和 YIARI 野生动物康复基金会称，这些猩猩是从印度尼西亚西加里曼丹省农村的种植园中获救的，由于大火切断了它们通往森林家园的通道，它们被困在那里。 该部和 YIARI 在一份联合声明中表示，距离发现这群极度濒危灵长类动物的地方仅 200 米（656 英尺）处发生大火。 声明称：“这种情况使猩猩没有安全路线返回栖息地；它们只能从一个种植园迁移到另一个种植园。” “除了面临火焰和烟雾的威胁之外，猩猩在种植园之间的活动也有可能增加与（人类）社区的互动和冲突。” 周五，在居民和种植园工人的帮助下，四只猩猩获救，周二，另一对母婴也获救。 救援人员必须对动物进行麻醉，以最大程度地减少压力和受伤风险。所有六人都被送往吉打邦镇的 YIARI 康复中心。 红毛猩猩是婆罗洲岛和苏门答腊岛的特有种，这两个地方受野火打击最严重，烧毁了大片土地，喷出的腐臭烟雾甚至蔓延到了马来西亚和新加坡。 印度尼西亚政府表示，1 月至 7 月期间，全国有超过 202,000 公顷土地被烧毁。八月份的数据尚未公布。 Nusantara Atlas 项目使这一数字接近 300,000 公顷，周四估计为 895,657 公顷，其中包括 8 月份。 上周，欧盟哥白尼大气监测局表示，火灾产生的雾霾是 24 年来最严重的 8 月份。 印度尼西亚的旱季通常从七月到十月，今年由于强烈的厄尔尼诺天气现象而变得更糟。 野火排放的 PM2.5 颗粒达到危险水平，这些颗粒非常小，可以深入肺部甚至血液，可能造成严重的健康后果。 根据绿色和平组织使用政府数据的估计，印度尼西亚约有 3500 万人暴露在有毒雾霾中。 国家减灾机构发言人 Berton Panjaitan 周四在雅加达告诉记者，大约 43,000 名消防员被部署扑灭大火。 他说，一艘日本海军舰艇和三架直升机已经抵达西加里曼丹......

reflection.en: The plight of these six orangutans, trapped by fires and separated from their forest homes, calls to mind the vulnerability of creatures who cannot speak for themselves. Proverbs 31:8-9 reminds us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all their rights." In this instance, rescuers are giving voice and action to the silent suffering of...
reflection.zh: 这六只猩猩被大火困住，与它们的森林家园隔绝，它们的困境提醒我们那些无法为自己发声的生物的脆弱。《箴言》31:8-9 提醒我们：“要为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者伸冤。” 在此案例中，救援人员为这些濒危动物无声的痛苦发出了声音并采取了行动。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Dangerous heat days are expanding beyond summer, with regional spring-fall shifts
title.zh: 危险高温天数已超出夏季范围，区域性春季和秋季出现变化

summary.en: Extreme heat, once confined to summer, is now appearing more frequently in the spring and fall. A new study indicates these shifts make heat harder on the body due to lack of acclimatization and more challenging for communities to prepare for, as cooling systems may not be in place or have been put away.
summary.zh: 极端高温曾仅限于夏季，但现在在春季和秋季也更频繁地出现。一项新研究表明，这种变化由于人们尚未适应季节而使高温对身体更具伤害性，也使社区更难应对，因为可能尚未安装或已收起降温系统。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Extreme heat has become more common—both research and lived experience document this—but when it arrives is a different question. A new study finds that, rather than occurring only during warm seasons, extreme heat events have become more frequent in the months before and after, too.

That timing matters. Extreme heat is harder on the body when it comes before people have acclimated to the season or after people have already had to endure months of it. It's also harder for communities to prepare for, since cooling centers and heat alerts are built around a summer calendar.

"In some places, we have a larger expansion of extreme heat during the spring, before the traditional heat season starts. In other places, there's a much faster expansion of the heat season into fall," says Catherine Ivanovich, lead author of the new study, which appears in AGU Advances. Ivanovich is a climatologist at NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies (GISS), which is affiliated with the Columbia Climate School.

Research on seasonal warming has tended to concentrate on average temperatures and shifts in the timing of seasons. Summer weather conditions in midlatitude regions, for example, have lengthened by roughly six days per decade since 1990. Little, if any, research has addressed the timing of individual extreme heat events, which may not move in step with the seasonal average.

Ivanovich and her colleagues, fellow GISS climate scientist Benjamin Cook and New York University's Sonali Shukla McDermid, expected that rising global temperatures associated with climate change would make it uniformly easier to cross dangerous heat thresholds throughout the year. That's not what they found.

The researchers counted extreme heat events on the six inhabited continents between 1980 and 1989, defining "extreme" as days in the hottest 5% of daily temperatures. They did this twice: once using standard thermometer readings, a measure of dry heat, and once using wet-bulb globe temperature , a measure of humid heat that combines humidity, solar radiation and air temperature to quantify heat stress as the human body experiences it.

The authors then compared those 1980s baseline figures with the most recent decade in the record, 2015 through 2024. The analysis found that extreme heat seasons had expanded significantly across just over half the world's land area for dry heat and just under half for humid heat. They had expanded lopsidedly, pushing further into spring in some regions and fall in others.

In the western United States, eastern China, northern Africa and eastern Europe, extreme heat events...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 极端高温已经变得越来越普遍——研究和生活经验都证明了这一点——但它何时到来却是一个不同的问题。一项新的研究发现，极端高温事件不仅发生在温暖的季节，而且在前后几个月也变得更加频繁。 这个时机很重要。当人们在适应这个季节之前或已经忍受了几个月之后，酷热对身体来说会更加困难。由于降温中心和高温警报是围绕夏季日历建立的，因此社区也更难做好准备。 这项发表在 AGU Advances 上的新研究的主要作者凯瑟琳·伊万诺维奇 (Catherine Ivanovich) 表示：“在一些地方，在传统的高温季节开始之前，春季期间极端高温的情况会更加严重。而在其他地方，高温季节会以更快的速度延伸到秋季。”伊万诺维奇是美国宇航局戈达德空间研究所 (GISS) 的气候学家，该研究所隶属于哥伦比亚气候学院。 关于季节性变暖的研究往往集中在平均气温和季节变化上。例如，自 1990 年以来，中纬度地区的夏季天气状况每十年延长约六天。几乎没有研究（如果有的话）解决个别极端高温事件的时间问题，这些事件可能与季节平均值不一致。 伊万诺维奇和她的同事、GISS 气候科学家本杰明·库克和纽约大学的索纳利·舒克拉·麦克德米德预计，与气候变化相关的全球气温上升将使全年更容易跨越危险的高温阈值。那不是他们发现的。 研究人员统计了 1980 年至 1989 年间六大有人居住的大陆发生的极端高温事件，将“极端”定义为每日气温最热 5% 的日子。他们这样做了两次：一次使用标准温度计读数，一种干热测量方法，一次使用湿球温度，一种湿热测量方法，结合了湿度、太阳辐射和气温，以量化人体所经历的热应激。 然后，作者将 20 世纪 80 年代的基线数据与有记录的最近十年（2015 年至 2024 年）进行了比较。分析发现，极端炎热季节显着扩大，覆盖了全球干热陆地面积的一半以上和湿热陆地面积的一半以下。它们的扩张不平衡，一些地区进一步进入春季，而另一些地区则陷入衰退。 在美国西部、中国东部、北非和东欧，极端高温事件……

reflection.en: The study reveals that extreme heat is no longer a summer-only phenomenon, extending into spring and fall. This prolonged exposure, especially when bodies haven't acclimated, can be deeply taxing. For those feeling worn down by these extended environmental challenges, the promise of renewed strength offers a profound hope.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了极端高温已不再是夏季独有的现象，而是延伸到了春季和秋季。这种延长的暴露，尤其是在身体尚未适应的情况下，会造成极大的消耗。对于那些因这些延长的环境挑战而感到疲惫不堪的人们，更新力量的应许带来了深刻的希望。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

The Psalmist marvels at the Creator's wisdom evident in the vastness and variety of life, reminding us of the profound order within creation, even as we observe its changing patterns.

This persistent inquiry, driven by observation and intellect, mirrors the ancient wisdom that creation itself holds profound lessons. May this potential breakthrough remind us that even in the deepest mysteries, Yahweh's...
reflection.zh: 数十年来，人类一直在努力理解塑造宇宙的看不见的力量，试图揭示宇宙隐藏的结构。这种由观察和智慧驱动的持久探索，与古老的智慧不谋而合——即创造本身蕴含着深刻的教训。愿这一潜在的突破提醒我们，即使在最深的奥秘中，雅伟精妙的设计也通过耐心探索得以显现。

title.en: Drax ash mound extraction plan approved
title.zh: 德拉克斯灰堆提取计划获批

summary.en: Plans to extract and reuse millions of tonnes of ash from a mound next to Drax Power Station have been approved. The ash will be used in construction products, reducing the need for virgin materials, with extraction continuing until 2045 and restoration completed by 2055.
summary.zh: 德拉克斯发电站旁边一个灰堆的数百万吨灰烬的提取和再利用计划已获批准。这些灰烬将用于建筑产品，减少对原生材料的需求，提取工作将持续到2045年，修复工作将于2055年完成。

body.en:
Plans to extract up to 23.5 million tonnes of ash from a disposal site next to Drax Power Station have been approved.

The 161-hectare (398 acre) mound, immediately north-west of the power station near Selby, reaches up to 39 metres (128ft) and has been used for ash deposits from Drax since the 1970s.

The scheme would see ash recovered for use in construction products such as concrete, reducing the need for virgin aggregates, with extraction continuing until 2045 and restoration completed by 2055.

Although North Yorkshire Council approved the application by Drax Power Ltd, it imposed conditions on when the site could be worked following concerns from residents.

Objections from three people cited concerns about dust, noise, lighting, air pollution and the impact on the landscape.

Concerns were also raised about habitat loss, the scale and duration of the scheme, and the removal of screening that helps shield Drax Power Station from nearby communities, according to the Local Democracy Reporting Service .

Councillor Tim Thrall, from Barlow Parish Council, who spoke at the planning meeting, said in principle they had "no objection to the removal of the ash mound."

He added: "However, we do have a number of concerns about whether mitigation measures are enough to impact the quality of life of the residents of the village."

Another councillor Mark Crane, whose area includes Barlow, said proposals that the site was to operate 18 hours a day, from 06:00 until midnight, seven days a week excluding bank holidays, "blew his mind".

He added: "To expect them to accept that they can work from six in the morning till midnight every single day of the year is, I'm sorry, completely unreasonable."

The planning committee agreed the site could only be worked from 08:00 until 20:00, excluding Sundays and bank holidays.

The committee also agreed a condition to ensure that 65% of the ash was transported by rail with the remainder removed by road.

Council officers concluded that, subject to conditions, the development would not result in unacceptable impacts on residents, highways, ecology, air quality or the water environment.

The approval was also subject to a legal agreement that includes a £200,000 fund to help mitigate its impact on the surrounding landscape.
body.zh: 从 Drax 发电站旁边的处置场提取多达 2350 万吨灰烬的计划已获得批准。 这座占地 161 公顷（398 英亩）的土丘位于塞尔比附近发电站的西北部，高达 39 米（128 英尺），自 20 世纪 70 年代以来一直用于存放德拉克斯的火山灰。 该计划将回收灰烬用于混凝土等建筑产品，减少对原始骨料的需求，提取将持续到 2045 年，恢复工作将在 2055 年完成。 尽管北约克郡议会批准了德拉克斯电力有限公司的申请，但考虑到居民的担忧，它对该工地的施工时间施加了条件。 三人的反对理由是担心灰尘、噪音、照明、空气污染和对景观的影响。 据当地民主报告服务处称，人们还对栖息地丧失、该计划的规模和持续时间以及帮助德拉克斯发电站免受附近社区影响的屏蔽设施的拆除表示担忧。 巴洛教区议会议员蒂姆·萨尔在规划会议上发言，他表示原则上他们“不反对拆除灰堆”。 他补充道：“然而，我们确实对缓解措施是否足以影响该村居民的生活质量存在一些担忧。” 另一位议员马克·克兰 (Mark Crane) 所在的地区包括巴洛 (Barlow)，他表示，该站点每周 7 天（不包括银行假日）每天从 06:00 运营到午夜 18 小时的提议“让他大吃一惊”。 他补充道：“抱歉，期望他们接受一年中每一天都可以从早上六点工作到午夜，这是完全不合理的。” 规划委员会同意该工地只能在 08:00 至 20:00 期间施工，周日和银行假日除外。 委员会还同意一项条件，确保 65% 的火山灰通过铁路运输，其余部分通过公路清除。 市议会官员的结论是，在条件允许的情况下，开发项目不会对居民、高速公路、生态、空气质量或水环境造成不可接受的影响。 该批准还取决于一项法律协议，其中包括 20 万英镑的基金，以帮助减轻其对周围景观的影响。

reflection.en: This plan to repurpose millions of tonnes of ash from Drax Power Station into construction materials is a practical example of stewardship. It echoes the Genesis account where, after creation, Yahweh declared all that was made 'very good,' implying a mandate for wise use and care of the earth's resources.
reflection.zh: 这项将德拉克斯发电站数百万吨灰烬再利用于建筑材料的计划，是管理资源的一个实际范例。它呼应了《创世记》的记载，即在创造之后，雅伟宣告一切所造的“甚好”，这暗示了明智地使用和照管地球资源的使命。

title.en: August joint-hottest month on record as climate change and El Niño drive heat
title.zh: 八月创纪录高温，欧洲气候机构称与七月并列

summary.en: August tied with July 2023 as the hottest month on record globally, driven by climate change and the El Niño phenomenon, with temperatures exceeding the critical 1.5C threshold above pre-industrial levels.
summary.zh: 根据欧盟气候服务机构的数据，八月与2023年七月并列成为有记录以来最热的月份，这归因于气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象，气温超过了工业化前水平1.5摄氏度的关键阈值。

body.en:
August was the joint-hottest month ever recorded, tying with July 2023, according to the EU's climate service.

The record was driven by a combination of climate change and the rising influence of El Niño, pushing heat into the atmosphere across the Pacific.

Temperatures for the month were 1.65C above pre-industrial levels - surpassing the critical 1.5C threshold agreed by countries to avoid the worst consequences of climate change.

While a single month above 1.5C does not mean it has been permanently crossed, it shows a trend towards breaching that limit.

The month also capped western Europe's warmest summer, with high temperatures pushing the season past the deadly heat of 2003.

Dr Samantha Burgess, strategic lead for climate at Copernicus, described August as "a remarkable month in the global climate record", and its impacts had been "increasingly being felt by communities, economies and ecosystems across the world".

The combination of record air temperatures, record ocean heat and Europe's exceptional summer showed how climate change was now driving extremes across "both the atmosphere and the oceans", she said.

UN climate chief Simon Stiell said the record clearly showed humanity's impact on the climate.

"The evidence is irrefutable: this is the spiralling price of humanity's fossil fuel addiction, and the global climate crisis it is fuelling," he said.

On top of the ongoing impact of the use of fossil fuels, the rise of a powerful El Niño is making matters worse, the researchers have said.

El Niño is a natural climate pattern in which a band of the eastern Pacific turns unusually warm, releasing vast amounts of stored ocean heat into the atmosphere and nudging global temperatures upwards for around a year.

The one currently being experienced is still strengthening and could become one of the most powerful on record, according to the Copernicus team.

The biggest impact of this natural phenomenon on global temperatures is expected to hit over the coming year, meaning the current run of records may have further to go.

That prospect follows a summer that drove western Europe to its warmest on record.

This was echoed in the UK, which had its hottest summer since records began in 1884 - a high mark the Met Office found had been made around 130 times more likely by human-caused climate change.

This figures carried "a very real human cost", said Dr Clair Barnes, an extreme weather researcher at Imperial College London.

The heat across the UK and Europe disrupted schools, strained hospitals, hit food production, fuelled fires and drought, and claiming "tens of thousands of lives", she said.

"Until we stop burning fossil fuels these records will continue to tumble, and the extremes will worsen faster than we are able to adapt. Crucially,...
body.zh: 根据欧盟气候服务机构的数据，8 月是有记录以来最热的月份，与 2023 年 7 月持平。 这一纪录是由气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象的影响不断加大共同推动的，厄尔尼诺现象将热量推入太平洋彼岸的大气中。 本月气温比工业化前水平高出 1.65 摄氏度，超过了各国为避免气候变化造成最严重后果而商定的 1.5 摄氏度临界阈值。 虽然单月气温高于 1.5 摄氏度并不意味着它已被永久突破，但它显示出突破该限制的趋势。 这个月也结束了西欧最温暖的夏季，高温使这个季节超越了 2003 年的酷热天气。 哥白尼气候战略主管萨曼莎·伯吉斯博士将八月描述为“全球气候记录中非凡的一个月”，其影响“越来越多地被世界各地的社区、经济和生态系统所感受到”。 她说，创纪录的气温、创纪录的海洋热量和欧洲异常的夏季结合在一起，表明气候变化正在如何推动“大气和海洋”出现极端现象。 联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔表示，这一记录清楚地表明了人类对气候的影响。 他说：“证据是无可辩驳的：这就是人类对化石燃料成瘾的螺旋式上升的价格，以及它正在加剧的全球气候危机。” 研究人员表示，除了使用化石燃料造成的持续影响之外，强大的厄尔尼诺现象的兴起也使情况变得更糟。 厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然气候模式，东太平洋的一段区域变得异常温暖，将大量储存的海洋热量释放到大气中，并推动全球气温在一年左右的时间里上升。 据哥白尼团队称，目前正在经历的这一事件仍在加强，并可能成为有记录以来最强大的之一。 这种自然现象对全球气温的最大影响预计将在明年出现，这意味着目前的记录可能还会进一步延续。 这一前景是在西欧经历了有记录以来最温暖的夏季之后发生的。 英国也出现了这种情况，该国正经历自 1884 年有记录以来最热的夏季——英国气象局发现，人为气候变化的可能性增加了约 130 倍。 伦敦帝国理工学院极端天气研究员克莱尔·巴恩斯博士说，这个数字带来了“非常真实的人力成本”。 她说，英国和欧洲各地的高温天气扰乱了学校，使医院不堪重负，影响了粮食生产，加剧了火灾和干旱，并夺去了“数万人的生命”。 “在我们停止燃烧化石燃料之前，这些记录将继续下降，极端情况的恶化速度将超过我们能够适应的速度。至关重要的是……

reflection.en: The Earth, with its intricate systems and delicate balance, is a testament to its Creator. As we witness record-breaking heat, it calls us to remember that this planet is not ours to exploit, but a sacred trust to steward with wisdom and care. May we approach our responsibility with humility, recognizing Yahweh's ownership and seeking to live in harmony...
reflection.zh: 地球及其错综复杂的系统和微妙的平衡，是其创造主的明证。当我们目睹创纪录的高温时，这提醒我们，这片土地并非供我们予取予求，而是我们应以智慧和关爱来管理的圣洁信托。愿我们以谦卑的态度承担起责任，认识到雅伟才是这片土地的主宰，并寻求与祂的创造和谐共处。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Distant sensors announced a fearsome tsunami’s birth
title.zh: 遥感器宣布了可怕海啸的诞生

summary.en: Scientists have pinpointed the collapse of an underwater volcano and revealed how its eruption triggered a destructive tsunami, using seismic data to understand the event.
summary.zh: 科学家们利用地震数据，精确定位了海底火山的崩塌，并揭示了其喷发如何引发了一场破坏性的海啸。

reflection.en: The deep ocean holds immense power, and its volcanic fury can unleash devastating tsunamis. Yet, even in such destructive events, there is a profound wisdom in the intricate systems of creation that scientists can observe and learn from. Yahweh's creation is full of wonders, revealing His wisdom to those who seek it.
reflection.zh: 深海蕴藏着巨大的力量，其火山爆发会引发毁灭性的海啸。然而，即使在如此破坏性的事件中，创造的复杂系统也蕴含着深刻的智慧，供科学家观察和学习。雅伟的创造充满了奇迹，向那些寻求它的人揭示祂的智慧。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: AI researchers reckon with the $1.5 million ‘academia tax’
title.zh: 人工智能研究人员正在应对 150 万美元的“学术税”

summary.en: Academics explain that their research freedom beats the increased salary they would get in the corporate sector, but emerging hybrid models might allow them to get the best of both worlds.
summary.zh: 学者们解释说，他们的研究自由胜过他们在企业界能获得的更高薪水，但新兴的混合模式可能让他们兼顾两全其美。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, even when costly, is a deeply human endeavor. Proverbs 18:15 speaks to the value of understanding, suggesting that the diligent seeker will find it. This resonates with the dedication of AI researchers who prioritize intellectual freedom and discovery, even amidst financial challenges.
reflection.zh: 追求知识，即使代价高昂，也是一项深刻的人类事业。箴言 18:15 谈到了理解的价值，暗示勤奋的寻求者终将找到它。这与人工智能研究人员的奉献精神产生了共鸣，他们即使在面临财务挑战时，也优先考虑智力自由和发现。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Indonesian foragers may have sucked on mind-altering nuts 25,000 years ago, research finds
title.zh: 印尼古人类25000年前可能嚼食致幻坚果，研究发现

summary.en: Analysis of two skeletons reveals tooth wear and traces of a psychoactive substance, suggesting what may be the earliest known evidence of human drug-taking among ancient Indonesian foragers 25,000 years ago.
summary.zh: 对两具古代印尼觅食者遗骸的分析显示出牙齿磨损和精神活性物质的痕迹，这可能是迄今已知最早的人类用药证据，可追溯至25000年前。

body.en: Analysis of two skeletons reveals tooth wear and traces of psychoactive substance in what may be earliest known evidence for human drug taking What may be the earliest known evidence for human drug taking has been traced to ancient Indonesian foragers who sucked on mind-altering nuts as long as 25,000 years ago. Analysis of two exceptionally rare skeletons from the Indonesian island of Sulawesi revealed dramatic tooth wear and traces of a psychoactive substance in the individuals’ remaining teeth, suggesting they routinely sucked on hard, abrasive betel nuts. Continue reading...
body.zh: 对两具骨骼的分析揭示了牙齿磨损和精神活性物质的痕迹，这可能是人类吸毒的最早已知证据。 已知最早的人类吸毒证据可以追溯到古代印度尼西亚采集者，他们早在 25,000 年前就吸食了改变精神的坚果。对印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛的两具极其罕见的骨骼进行的分析显示，这些人的牙齿磨损严重，并且在剩余的牙齿中发现了精神活性物质的痕迹，这表明他们经常吮吸坚硬、磨蚀性的槟榔。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of ancient Indonesian foragers using mind-altering nuts 25,000 years ago, revealed through meticulous analysis of skeletal remains, reminds us that creation itself holds deep lessons. Job 12:7-9 speaks to this, urging us to ask the animals and birds, and to learn from the earth, for all of creation declares the wisdom of its Maker.
reflection.zh: 在印度尼西亚古代觅食者25000年前使用致幻坚果的发现，通过对骨骼遗骸的细致分析得以揭示，这提醒我们，造物本身蕴含着深刻的教训。约伯记12:7-9呼应了这一点，敦促我们去询问走兽飞鸟，并从大地那里学习，因为万物都在宣告其造物主的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scientists find a bone-building switch that could fight osteoporosis
title.zh: 科学家发现骨骼生长开关，或可对抗骨质疏松症

summary.en: Researchers have identified an experimental compound, AP503, that significantly strengthens bones in mice by activating the GPR133 receptor, which promotes bone formation and reduces bone loss. This discovery holds potential for new osteoporosis treatments, especially as existing therapies have limitations and side...
summary.zh: 研究人员发现一种名为AP503的实验性化合物，通过激活GPR133受体，显著增强了小鼠的骨骼，该受体可促进骨骼形成并减缓骨骼流失。这一发现为骨质疏松症的新疗法带来了潜力，尤其考虑到现有疗法存在局限性和副作用。该化合物也显示出增强肌肉的潜力。

body.en:
Osteoporosis, a condition that weakens bones and increases the risk of fractures, affects millions of people and remains a major challenge for doctors seeking safe treatments that can be used over long periods. In Germany alone, about six million people are affected, most of them women.

Because existing therapies can have limitations and side effects, researchers are looking for new biological targets that could lead to more effective ways of preserving or rebuilding bone. Scientists at Leipzig University have now identified one such target in GPR133, a receptor that appears to play an important role in keeping bones strong.

GPR133 belongs to a group known as adhesion G protein-coupled receptors. These receptors sit on the surface of cells and help them respond to signals from their surroundings. Although this family of receptors is still not fully understood, the new findings suggest GPR133 is closely involved in the processes that build and maintain healthy bone.

"If this receptor is impaired by genetic changes, mice show signs of loss of bone density at an early age - similar to osteoporosis in humans. Using the substance AP503, which was only recently identified via a computer-assisted screen as a stimulator of GPR133, we were able to significantly increase bone strength in both healthy and osteoporotic mice," explains Professor Ines Liebscher, lead investigator of the study from the Rudolf Schönheimer Institute of Biochemistry at the Faculty of Medicine.

The results point to GPR133 as a potentially valuable target for future osteoporosis treatments. The researchers found that stimulating the receptor with AP503 increased bone strength not only in healthy mice, but also in mice with osteoporosis-like bone loss.

Inside bone tissue, GPR133 responds to physical forces and interactions between nearby bone cells. When the receptor is activated, it sets off signaling that changes the balance between the cells that build bone and those that break it down.

Bone-forming cells (osteoblasts) are responsible for producing new bone tissue. Bone-resorbing cells (osteoclasts), by contrast, remove old bone as part of the skeleton's normal cycle of renewal. Healthy bones depend on maintaining the right balance between these two processes.

Activation of GPR133 encourages the activity of osteoblasts while reducing the activity of osteoclasts. This shifts the balance toward stronger and more durable bone.

AP503 appears to imitate the natural process that activates GPR133. That raises the possibility that the compound could eventually be used to increase bone strength or help restore bone that has already been weakened. One potential application would be osteoporosis associated with menopause, when declining hormone levels can accelerate bone loss in...
body.zh: 骨质疏松症是一种削弱骨骼并增加骨折风险的疾病，影响数百万人，对于寻求可长期使用的安全治疗方法的医生来说仍然是一个重大挑战。仅在德国，就有约 600 万人受到影响，其中大多数是女性。 由于现有疗法可能存在局限性和副作用，研究人员正在寻找新的生物靶点，以找到更有效的保存或重建骨骼的方法。莱比锡大学的科学家现已在 GPR133 中发现了一个这样的靶标，GPR133 是一种似乎在保持骨骼强健方面发挥重要作用的受体。 GPR133 属于粘附 G 蛋白偶联受体组。这些受体位于细胞表面，帮助它们对周围环境的信号做出反应。尽管这个受体家族仍未被完全了解，但新发现表明 GPR133 密切参与构建和维持健康骨骼的过程。 “如果这种受体因基因变化而受损，小鼠就会在幼年时表现出骨密度下降的迹象，类似于人类的骨质疏松症。使用最近通过计算机辅助屏幕识别出的 AP503 物质作为 GPR133 的刺激剂，我们能够显着提高健康小鼠和骨质疏松小鼠的骨强度，”该研究的首席研究员、医学院 Rudolf Schönheimer 生物化学研究所的 Ines Liebscher 教授解释道。 结果表明 GPR133 是未来骨质疏松症治疗的潜在有价值的靶点。研究人员发现，用 AP503 刺激受体不仅可以增加健康小鼠的骨强度，还可以增加患有骨质疏松症样骨质流失的小鼠的骨强度。 在骨组织内部，GPR133 对物理力和附近骨细胞之间的相互作用做出反应。当受体被激活时，它会发出信号，改变构建骨骼的细胞和分解骨骼的细胞之间的平衡。 成骨细胞（成骨细胞）负责产生新的骨组织。相比之下，骨吸收细胞（破骨细胞）会去除旧骨，作为骨骼正常更新周期的一部分。健康的骨骼取决于保持这两个过程之间的适当平衡。 GPR133 的激活会促进成骨细胞的活性，同时降低破骨细胞的活性。这将使骨骼变得更坚固、更耐用。 AP503 似乎模仿激活 GPR133 的自然过程。这增加了这种化合物最终可用于增加骨骼强度或帮助恢复已经削弱的骨骼的可能性。一种潜在的应用是与更年期相关的骨质疏松症，激素水平下降会加速骨质流失......

reflection.en: The discovery of how to activate bone-building processes in mice offers a glimpse into the intricate wisdom embedded within creation. Like the ancient Job, we can learn profound truths by observing the natural world, recognizing the Creator's design in the very fabric of life. This scientific pursuit reflects a deep human desire to understand and heal,...
reflection.zh: 在小鼠身上发现激活骨骼生长过程的方法，让我们得以一窥造物中蕴含的精妙智慧。正如古时的约伯，我们可以通过观察自然界获得深刻的真理，认识到生命本质中造物主的创造设计。这项科学探索反映了人类对理解和治愈的深切渴望，也呼应了造物主自身的修复之工。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Ozempic and Wegovy linked to nearly 40% fewer asthma attacks
title.zh: 奥泽平与维格威与哮喘发作减少近40%相关

summary.en: A large real-world study found that semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, was associated with a nearly 40% reduction in asthma attacks and about a 20% decrease in COPD flare-ups. Researchers suggest that GLP-1 drugs might offer respiratory benefits.
summary.zh: 一项大型真实世界研究发现，奥泽平（Ozempic）和维格威（Wegovy）中的活性成分司美格鲁肽（semaglutide）与哮喘发作减少近40%以及慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）急性加重减少约20%相关。研究人员推测，GLP-1类药物可能具有呼吸益处。

body.en:
Semaglutide, a medication widely used for type 2 diabetes and weight loss, may also provide an unexpected benefit for people with asthma. New research presented at the European Respiratory Society (ERS) Congress in Barcelona, Spain, found that semaglutide use was associated with a reduction in asthma attacks of nearly 40%.

The study was led by Professor Chloe Bloom, Clinical Associate Professor in Respiratory Epidemiology at the National Heart & Lung Institute, Imperial College London, UK, and presented by Dr. Bohee Lee.

Dr. Bloom said: "GLP-1 receptor agonists are widely used to treat type 2 diabetes and obesity. Previous research suggests that they may have anti-inflammatory effects and may improve lung-related outcomes. However, asthma and COPD outcomes have not been included as outcomes in GLP-1 drug trials.

"We wanted to use real-world health records to investigate whether people with asthma or COPD who started GLP-1 receptor agonists had fewer acute respiratory attacks."

To investigate that question, the researchers analyzed electronic medical records from the UK. They carried out four parallel studies, each involving between 20,000 and 22,000 people who had started treatment with either a GLP-1 medication or a different type of diabetes drug known as a sulfonylurea.

The results suggested that people with airway diseases such as asthma and COPD who received GLP-1 therapies experienced fewer asthma attacks and COPD flare-ups than comparable patients who were prescribed other diabetes medications.

Among the GLP-1 drugs examined, semaglutide appeared to stand out, particularly for people with asthma.

Bloom explains: "The effect was strongest with semaglutide, especially in people with asthma, where use of semaglutide appears to be associated with nearly a 40% reduction in asthma attacks. Semaglutide also led to a 20% reduction in COPD flare-ups."

The findings suggest that people who already qualify for GLP-1 receptor agonists because they have obesity or type 2 diabetes could potentially receive an additional benefit for their respiratory health.

However, Bloom emphasized that the results are not enough to recommend these medications specifically as treatments for asthma or COPD.

She explains: "The findings from this study are encouraging, but they should not change treatment decisions on their own. People with asthma or COPD should not start GLP-1 receptor agonists specifically for their lung condition outside current prescribing guidance. While the findings suggest that some people taking GLP-1 receptor agonists may experience fewer respiratory attacks, this needs confirmation in clinical trials."

Dr. Alexander Mathioudakis, Chair of the European Respiratory Society's Group on Airway Pharmacology and Treatment and Senior Lecturer in...
body.zh: 索马鲁肽是一种广泛用于治疗 2 型糖尿病和减肥的药物，也可能为哮喘患者带来意想不到的益处。在西班牙巴塞罗那举行的欧洲呼吸学会 (ERS) 大会上发表的新研究发现，使用索马鲁肽可使哮喘发作减少近 40%。 该研究由英国伦敦帝国理工学院国家心肺研究所呼吸流行病学临床副教授 Chloe Bloom 教授领导，并由 Bohee Lee 博士介绍。 Bloom博士说：“GLP-1受体激动剂广泛用于治疗2型糖尿病和肥胖症。之前的研究表明它们可能具有抗炎作用，并可能改善肺部相关的结果。然而，哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺病的结果尚未被纳入GLP-1药物试验的结果中。 “我们希望利用真实世界的健康记录来调查患有哮喘或慢性阻塞性肺病的患者在开始使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂后是否较少发生急性呼吸道疾病。” 为了调查这个问题，研究人员分析了来自英国的电子病历。他们进行了四项平行研究，每项研究涉及 20,000 至 22,000 名已开始使用 GLP-1 药物或另一种称为磺酰脲类的糖尿病药物进行治疗的人。 结果表明，患有哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺病等气道疾病的患者接受 GLP-1 治疗后，与服用其他糖尿病药物的患者相比，哮喘发作和慢性阻塞性肺病发作的次数更少。 在检查的 GLP-1 药物中，索马鲁肽似乎脱颖而出，特别是对于哮喘患者。 Bloom 解释说：“索马鲁肽的效果最强，尤其是对于哮喘患者，使用索马鲁肽似乎可以使哮喘发作减少近 40%。索马鲁肽还使 COPD 发作减少了 20%。” 研究结果表明，因患有肥胖症或 2 型糖尿病而已经有资格使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂的人可能会获得对呼吸系统健康的额外益处。 然而，布鲁姆强调，这些结果不足以推荐这些药物专门用于治疗哮喘或慢性阻塞性肺病。 她解释说：“这项研究的结果令人鼓舞，但它们不应该自行改变治疗决定。哮喘或慢性阻塞性肺病患者不应在当前处方指南之外开始专门针对其肺部状况使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂。虽然研究结果表明，一些服用 GLP-1 受体激动剂的人可能会减少呼吸道疾病的发作，但这需要临床试验的证实。” Alexander Mathioudakis 博士，欧洲呼吸学会气道药理学和治疗小组主席，高级讲师...

reflection.en: It is a profound comfort when scientific inquiry uncovers unexpected avenues for healing. This research, linking GLP-1 drugs to fewer asthma attacks, echoes the ancient wisdom of bringing our concerns for the sick to God. May we continue to seek and share knowledge that alleviates suffering, trusting in divine wisdom that guides discovery.
reflection.zh: 当科学探究揭示出意想不到的疗愈途径时，这是一种深刻的安慰。这项研究将GLP-1类药物与哮喘发作减少联系起来，呼应了将病人忧虑带到雅伟面前的古老智慧。愿我们继续寻求和分享减轻痛苦的知识，信靠那引导发现的神圣智慧。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Have we found alien life? Hundreds of scientists weigh in
title.zh: 我们找到外星生命了吗？数百名科学家发表看法

summary.en: Two major announcements in 2025 regarding potential alien life generated significant excitement. However, a survey revealed that most astrobiologists remain unconvinced, with only 6.6% believing that possible biological molecules on K2-18b likely represent extraterrestrial life, and 15.1% holding the same view for...
summary.zh: 2025年关于潜在外星生命的两项重大公告引起了巨大轰动。然而，一项调查显示，大多数天体生物学家仍持怀疑态度，只有6.6%的人认为K2-18b上可能的生物分子很可能代表外星生命，另有15.1%的人对火星上的发现持相同看法。

body.en:
It may seem like we are on the verge of discovering alien life. In 2025, a press release stated that we have the “ strongest hints yet ” of extraterrestrial life on the exoplanet K2-18b. And when talking about a collected sample from a rock named “Cheyava Falls” on Mars, NASA Administrator Sean Duffy said this was the “ closest we have ever come ” to discovering life on the red planet.

Such moments capture the imagination. But they also raise an important question: what do the majority of scientists actually think?

Surprisingly, we usually don’t know. When a scientific controversy or breakthrough dominates headlines, press officers and journalists often quote a handful of experts. These views may be insightful, but they rarely tell us what the wider scientific community thinks. And yet public discussions frequently rely on phrases such as “the science says” or “scientists believe”, as if there were a clear and measurable answer.

In reality, systematic evidence about scientific opinion is often missing. My colleagues and I recently tried to change that in the domain of astrobiology. Shortly after the two major announcements of possible extraterrestrial life in 2025, we surveyed astrobiologists to understand how expert judgment was distributed across the field.

The first case concerned the exoplanet K2-18b. In April 2025, researchers reported possible traces of molecules called dimethyl sulfide and/or dimethyl disulfide. On Earth, these are associated with biological activity. Media coverage was extensive, with many reports framing the finding as an extraordinary advance in the search for alien life.

The second case came in September, when NASA announced that Cheyava Falls appeared to preserve a potential biosignature – so-called “leopard spots” which are mineral rings that on Earth are often formed by microbial activity. Again, headlines, and NASA officials themselves, suggested something momentous.

We surveyed hundreds of astrobiologists from across the global research community, within days of each announcement. We asked a simple question: did scientists think extraterrestrial life had probably been found?

The results revealed a rather cautious picture. For K2-18b, only 6.6% of surveyed astrobiologists agreed that scientists had probably found extraterrestrial life. Nearly two-thirds disagreed, while 28.0% remained neutral. For the Mars case, confidence was higher but still cautious: 15.1% agreed, disagreement fell to 44.6% and neutrality rose to 40.3%.

Looking only at agreement and disagreement, however, misses an important part of the story. The proportion of astrobiologists who strongly disagreed fell dramatically, from 35.1% in the K2-18b case to just...
body.zh: 看起来我们正处于发现外星生命的边缘。 2025 年，一份新闻稿称，我们在系外行星 K2-18b 上获得了“迄今为止最强烈​​的迹象”，表明存在外星生命。在谈到从火星上名为“Cheyava Falls”的岩石收集的样本时，美国宇航局局长肖恩·达菲表示，这是我们“最接近”在这颗红色星球上发现生命的一次。 这样的时刻激发了人们的想象力。但他们也提出了一个重要的问题：大多数科学家实际上是怎么想的？ 令人惊讶的是，我们通常不知道。当科学争议或突破占据头条新闻时，新闻官员和记者经常引用少数专家的观点。这些观点可能很有洞察力，但它们很少告诉我们更广泛的科学界的想法。然而，公众讨论经常依赖“科学说”或“科学家相信”等短语，仿佛有一个明确且可衡量的答案。 事实上，关于科学观点的系统证据常常缺失。我和我的同事最近试图在天体生物学领域改变这一现状。在两次重大宣布 2025 年可能存在外星生命之后不久，我们对天体生物学家进行了调查，以了解专家判断在整个领域的分布情况。 第一个案例涉及系外行星 K2-18b。 2025 年 4 月，研究人员报告了可能存在被称为二甲基硫醚和/或二甲基二硫醚的分子痕迹。在地球上，这些与生物活动有关。媒体报道广泛，许多报道将这一发现视为寻找外星生命的非凡进展。 第二个案例发生在九月，当时美国宇航局宣布切亚瓦瀑布似乎保留了潜在的生物特征——所谓的“豹斑”，这是地球上通常由微生物活动形成的矿物环。头条新闻和美国宇航局官员本人再次暗示了一些重大事件。 在每次发布后的几天内，我们对来自全球研究界的数百名天体生物学家进行了调查。我们问了一个简单的问题：科学家认为可能已经发现了外星生命吗？ 结果显示出相当谨慎的情况。对于 K2-18b，只有 6.6% 的受访天体生物学家认为科学家可能已经发现了外星生命。近三分之二的人不同意，28.0% 的人保持中立。对于火星案例，信心较高，但仍持谨慎态度：同意的比例为 15.1%，不同意的比例下降至 44.6%，中立的比例上升至 40.3%。 然而，只看同意和分歧，就忽略了故事的一个重要部分。强烈反对的天体生物学家比例急剧下降，从 K2-18b 案例中的 35.1% 降至仅......

reflection.en: The pursuit of life beyond Earth is a profound human endeavor, pushing the boundaries of our knowledge. Yet, as these scientists demonstrate, true discovery requires careful observation and a humble acknowledgment of what remains unknown. The natural world, in all its complexity, is a testament to wisdom, inviting us to learn from its intricate design.
reflection.zh: 对地球以外生命的探索是一项深刻的人类事业，它不断拓展我们知识的边界。然而，正如这些科学家所展示的，真正的发现需要仔细的观察，并谦虚地承认那些仍然未知的事物。大自然以其复杂性，本身就是智慧的明证，邀请我们从其精妙的设计中学习。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Highly efficient base editing at PCSK9 and normal human embryo development
title.zh: PCSK9的高效碱基编辑和正常人类胚胎发育

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11118-x Highly efficient base editing at PCSK9 and normal human embryo development
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，在线发表：2026年9月9日；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11118-x PCSK9的高效碱基编辑和正常人类胚胎发育

reflection.en: This research reports a significant advancement in gene editing technology, allowing for precise modifications within human embryos. As we gain the ability to alter the very blueprint of life, the Psalmist's reflection on being "fearfully and wonderfully made" invites contemplation. It calls us to approach such powerful capabilities with awe and a deep...
reflection.zh: 这项研究报告了基因编辑技术的重大进展，能够对人类胚胎进行精确的修改。当我们获得改变生命蓝图的能力时，诗篇作者关于“我被造，奇妙可畏”的反思邀请我们深思。它呼吁我们以敬畏之心和对人类生命精妙设计的深深尊重来运用如此强大的能力。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Marvel’s Wolverine review – a gloriously conflicted lead is let down by crude, boring battling
title.zh: 《金刚狼》评测——一个光辉而矛盾的主角被粗糙、无聊的战斗拖累

summary.en: The PlayStation 5 game 'Marvel's Wolverine' features a well-realized protagonist, Logan, and exquisite character art. However, it suffers from narrative and emotional arc lapses, with some combat sequences feeling like a chore, failing to live up to the potential of its dark and bloody character.
summary.zh: PlayStation 5游戏《金刚狼》中的主角洛根（Logan）由利亚姆·麦金太尔（Liam McIntyre）扮演，角色塑造精良，角色艺术也十分精美。然而，游戏在叙事和情感弧线上存在不足，部分战斗体验令人感到乏味，未能充分发挥其黑暗血腥角色的潜力。

body.en: PlayStation 5; Insomniac Games Logan is well realised by Liam McIntyre and some exquisite character art, but there are lapses in narrative and emotional arcs and some of the combat feels like a chore It was always going to be difficult to follow Spider-Man. Insomniac’s three games based around the web-slinger are masterpieces of superhero wish fulfilment, allowing you to swoop above a depiction of Manhattan alive with graffiti artists, roving journalists and gun-toting gangsters. If anyone should be up to the task, it’s Wolverine. A beloved Marvel stalwart, his life much darker and bloodier than Peter Parker’s, he seems the ideal protagonist for a moody action adventure. Yet somehow this well-made game falls short of its potential. Set years before the founding of the X-Men, Marvel’s Wolverine sees a disenfranchised Logan falling back in with Sabretooth and Mystique when their mentor Nathaniel Essex is kidnapped by mutant-hating billionaire Bolivar Trask. This archetypal tech bro has a disturbing plan for world domination and the X Team are out to stop him – but there is a secret buried in Wolverine’s past that’s about to cause an eruption. It’s a decent setup, filled with the sort of intrigue, violence and Freudian tension we expect from the X-Men. Continue reading...
body.zh: 游戏机 5； Insomniac Games 的《洛根》由利亚姆·麦金泰尔和一些精美的角色艺术完美地实现了，但在叙事和情感弧线上存在缺陷，而且一些战斗感觉像是一件苦差事。跟随蜘蛛侠总是很困难。 Insomniac 的三款基于网络投掷者的游戏是满足超级英雄愿望的杰作，让你飞翔在曼哈顿的上空，那里有涂鸦艺术家、流动记者和持枪歹徒。如果有人能胜任这项任务，那就是金刚狼。作为深受喜爱的漫威坚定支持者，他的生活比彼得·帕克的生活更加黑暗和血腥，他似乎是喜怒无常的动作冒险的理想主角。然而不知怎的，这款制作精良的游戏却未能发挥其潜力。故事背景设定在 X 战警成立几年前，漫威的金刚狼看到，当剑齿虎和魔形女的导师纳撒尼尔·埃塞克斯被仇恨变种人的亿万富翁玻利瓦尔·特拉斯克绑架时，被剥夺权利的洛根重新回到了他们身边。这位典型的科技兄弟有一个令人不安的统治世界计划，X 团队正全力阻止他 - 但金刚狼的过去中埋藏着一个即将引发爆发的秘密。这是一个不错的设定，充满了我们所期待的《X战警》中的阴谋、暴力和弗洛伊德式的紧张气氛。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age of rapid technological advancement, even sophisticated creations like video games can fall short of their promise. The review of 'Marvel's Wolverine' points to lapses in narrative and emotional depth, alongside tedious combat. This reminds us that true fulfillment, whether in art or life, requires more than just technical skill; it demands wisdom...
reflection.zh: 在这个技术飞速发展的时代，即使是像电子游戏这样精密的创作，也可能无法完全兑现其承诺。《金刚狼》的评测指出了其叙事和情感深度的不足，以及乏味的战斗体验。这提醒我们，无论是艺术还是生活中真正的满足，需要的不仅仅是技术技巧，更需要智慧以及对真正触动人心的事物的深刻理解。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Elon Musk attacks film-maker behind documentary about him
title.zh: 埃隆·马斯克抨击关于他的纪录片制片人

summary.en: Tech mogul Elon Musk has launched an angry verbal attack on Alex Gibney, the filmmaker behind a four-hour documentary about his life and influence. Musk referred to Gibney as a 'bitter old man' with 'zero integrity' in a series of posts on the social media platform X. Gibney, whose previous films covered topics like...
summary.zh: 科技巨头埃隆·马斯克在社交媒体平台X上发布了一系列帖子，愤怒地抨击了制作一部关于他生平和影响的四小时纪录片的电影制作人亚历克斯·吉布尼。马斯克称吉布尼为“年老的愤世嫉俗者”，并表示他“毫无诚信”。吉布尼曾制作过关于安然公司破产和弗拉基米尔·普京等题材的影片，本周在威尼斯电影节上首映了他的马斯克纪录片，并表示他认为这位世...

body.en: Tech mogul calls director Alex Gibney a ‘bitter old man’ who has ‘zero integrity’ in series of posts on X Elon Musk has issued an angry tirade at the film-maker behind a four-hour documentary about his life and influence, labelling the director Alex Gibney a “bitter old man” who has “zero integrity”. Gibney, who has previously made films about the collapse of Enron, WikiLeaks and Vladimir Putin, premiered his Musk documentary at the Venice film festival this week. He said he believed the world’s richest man was “extremely dangerous” . Continue reading...
body.zh: 科技大亨在 X 上的一系列帖子中称导演亚历克斯·吉布尼是一个“零诚信”的“苦老头”。埃隆·马斯克在一部关于他的生活和影响力的四小时纪录片背后对这位电影制片人发出了愤怒的长篇大论，称导演亚历克斯·吉布尼是一个“零诚信”的“苦老头”。吉布尼此前曾拍摄过有关安然公司、维基解密和弗拉基米尔·普京崩溃的电影，本周在威尼斯电影节上首映了他的马斯克纪录片。他说他认为世界首富“极其危险”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Words carry immense power, capable of building up or tearing down. Elon Musk's public denunciation of filmmaker Alex Gibney, labeling him a 'bitter old man,' demonstrates how harsh language can escalate conflict and damage reputations. The biblical proverb reminds us that careless or malicious words can inflict deep wounds, urging us to consider the impact...
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，既能建设也能摧毁。埃隆·马斯克公开谴责电影制作人亚历克斯·吉布尼，称他为“年老的愤世嫉俗者”，这表明恶毒的言语会加剧冲突并损害声誉。《圣经》中的箴言提醒我们，鲁莽或恶意的言语会造成深刻的伤害，促使我们反思自己言语的影响。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: OpenAI not on track to reduce risk of ‘catastrophic’ loss of control, says board member
title.zh: OpenAI 未能降低“灾难性”失控风险，董事会成员称

summary.en: Paul Christiano, a US government adviser and member of OpenAI's non-profit board, has warned that the company is not on track to adequately reduce the risk of catastrophic loss of control from advanced AI. He expressed concern that rapid advancements could lead to irreversible consequences in the near future, amidst...
summary.zh: 美国政府顾问、OpenAI 非营利基金会董事会成员保罗·克里斯蒂亚诺警告称，该公司未能按计划充分降低先进人工智能带来灾难性失控的风险。他表示担忧，人工智能能力的快速发展可能在不久的将来导致不可逆转的后果，这加剧了公众和政治界对超级智能人工智能可能对人类构成生存威胁的担忧。

body.en: US government adviser Paul Christiano warns of risks to AI industry as he joins OpenAI’s non-profit foundation OpenAI is not on track to reduce the risk of “catastrophic” loss of control to an acceptable level, a member of its non-profit board has said, amid spreading public and political concern that super-advanced AIs could one day wipe out humanity. Paul Christiano, a US government technology adviser, said : “There is a meaningful risk that rapid acceleration in AI capabilities leads to catastrophic and irreversible loss of control in the very near term.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国政府顾问 Paul Christiano 在加入 OpenAI 非营利基金会时警告人工智能行业面临风险。 OpenAI 非营利组织董事会成员表示，由于公众和政界普遍担心超先进人工智能有一天可能会消灭人类，OpenAI 并未走上将“灾难性”失控风险降低至可接受水平的轨道。美国政府技术顾问保罗·克里斯蒂安诺（Paul Christiano）表示：“人工智能能力的快速加速会在短期内导致灾难性的、不可逆转的失控，这是一个有意义的风险。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of advanced artificial intelligence, while promising, carries inherent risks. Paul Christiano's warning about OpenAI's trajectory toward potential catastrophic loss of control echoes the ancient wisdom that unchecked ambition and the relentless drive for power can lead to ruin. True progress requires not only innovation but also profound...
reflection.zh: 追求先进的人工智能固然充满希望，但也伴随着固有的风险。保罗·克里斯蒂亚诺关于 OpenAI 走向潜在灾难性失控的轨迹的警告，呼应了古老的智慧：不受约束的野心和对权力的不懈追求可能导致毁灭。真正的进步不仅需要创新，还需要深刻的谦卑和对安全的承诺，确保我们的创造物服务于人类，而不是危及人类。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Artemis II commander and pilot become NASA's first astronaut emeriti
title.zh: 阿尔忒弥斯二号指挥官和飞行员成为美国宇航局首批名誉宇航员

summary.en: Reid Wiseman and Victor Glover, the commander and pilot of NASA's Artemis II mission, have been named NASA's first astronauts emeriti. This new status allows them to continue supporting the Johnson Space Center in Houston by training and mentoring staff, while also pursuing outside opportunities, five months after...
summary.zh: 美国宇航局“阿尔忒弥斯二号”任务的指挥官和飞行员 Reid Wiseman 和 Victor Glover 在完成月球任务五个月后，被任命为美国宇航局首批名誉宇航员。这一新身份使他们能够继续在休斯顿约翰逊航天中心支持工作，培训和指导员工，同时也能追求外部机会。

body.en: The commander and pilot of NASA's Artemis II mission have gained a new distinction five months after splashing down from the Moon: They're not fully retiring from the space agency. Reid Wiseman and Victor Glover are the first astronauts to join NASA's emeritus program , enabling them to continue to support the work being done at Johnson Space Center in Houston. They will remain available to train and mentor the current workforce while still being able to pursue employment and opportunities outside of NASA. "I have asked NASA ... to not use the term 'retire' as much, but technically emeritus is a retirement program," Glover told collectSPACE.com on Wednesday. "It's something we have typically done for scientists when they have groundbreaking research, and they want to go back to academia to teach or to research and publish." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯二号任务的指挥官和飞行员在从月球坠落五个月后获得了新的荣誉：他们并没有完全从航天局退休。里德·怀斯曼和维克多·格洛弗是第一批加入美国宇航局荣誉退休计划的宇航员，使他们能够继续支持休斯敦约翰逊航天中心正在进行的工作。他们将继续培训和指导现有员工，同时仍然能够在 NASA 之外寻求就业和机会。 “我已经要求美国宇航局……不要过多使用‘退休’这个词，但从技术上讲，荣休是一个退休计划，”格洛弗周三告诉collectSPACE.com。 “这是我们通常为科学家做的事情，当他们进行突破性研究时，他们想回到学术界教学或研究和发表。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The careers of astronauts Reid Wiseman and Victor Glover are entering a new phase. Their transition to astronaut emeriti signifies a shift from active missions to a role of mentorship and continued support for NASA. This echoes the wisdom found in Ecclesiastes, reminding us that there is a season for every activity under heaven, including new chapters of...
reflection.zh: 宇航员 Reid Wiseman 和 Victor Glover 的职业生涯正在进入一个新阶段。他们转为名誉宇航员身份，标志着从现役任务转向指导和持续支持美国宇航局的角色。这呼应了传道书中发现的智慧，提醒我们“天下万务都有定时”，包括新的服务和贡献篇章。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Pixel 11 Pro review: Google’s best pocket camera goes customisable
title.zh: Pixel 11 Pro 评测：谷歌最佳便携相机支持定制

summary.en: Google's latest Pro phone, the Pixel 11 Pro, offers solid battery life, fast performance, and quality software in a compact design. It boasts a high-quality camera and emphasizes customisation, allowing users to significantly alter photo appearances beyond simple filters, even if it technically degrades the image...
summary.zh: 谷歌最新的 Pro 手机 Pixel 11 Pro 拥有扎实的电池续航、流畅的性能和优质的软件，机身小巧便携。它配备了出色的相机，并强调可定制性，允许用户对照片进行深度个性化调整，远超简单的滤镜，即使这可能在技术上降低照片质量。这款手机被认为是年度最佳小尺寸手机的有力竞争者。

body.en: Solid battery life, snappy performance and quality software make for a great smaller phone with a killer camera Google’s latest Pro phone is out to prove it has the best camera on a smartphone while embracing customisation, allowing you to change the look and feel of your photos far beyond simple filters even if that means making them technically worse. The Pixel 11 Pro packs the best of Google’s hardware and software into a still-pocketable and easy to handle frame, instantly making it a contender for best smaller phone of the year. Screen: 6.3in 120Hz QHD+ OLED (495ppi) Processor: Google Tensor G6 RAM: 12 or 16GB Storage: 256, 512GB or 1TB Operating system: Android 17 Camera: 50MP + 48MP UW + 48MP 5x tele; 42MP selfie Connectivity: 5G, eSIM, wifi 7, UWB, NFC, Bluetooth 6, Thread and GNSS Water resistance: IP68 (1.5m for 30 minutes) Dimensions: 152.7 x 71.9 x 8.4mm Weight: 204g Continue reading...
body.zh: 稳定的电池续航时间、快速的性能和优质的软件造就了一款配备杀手级相机的小型手机。谷歌最新的 Pro 手机旨在证明它拥有智能手机上最好的相机，同时支持自定义功能，让您可以改变照片的外观和感觉，远远超出简单的滤镜，即使这意味着它们在技术上会变得更糟。 Pixel 11 Pro 将谷歌最好的硬件和软件集成到一个仍然可以放在口袋里且易于操作的框架中，立即使其成为年度最佳小型手机的竞争者。屏幕：6.3 英寸 120Hz QHD+ OLED (495ppi) 处理器：Google Tensor G6 RAM：12 或 16GB 存储：256、512GB 或 1TB 操作系统：Android 17 相机：50MP + 48MP UW + 48MP 5x tele； 42MP 自拍 连接性：5G、eSIM、wifi 7、UWB、NFC、蓝牙 6、Thread 和 GNSS 防水性：IP68（1.5m 30 分钟） 尺寸：152.7 x 71.9 x 8.4mm 重量：204g 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless pace of technological advancement, exemplified by the new Pixel 11 Pro, mirrors the prophecy that 'knowledge will increase' (Daniel 12:4). As we embrace these powerful tools, may we also cultivate the wisdom to use them for good, remembering that true progress lies not just in capability, but in its ethical application.
reflection.zh: Pixel 11 Pro 这样的新产品所代表的技术进步日新月异，恰如但以理书所预言的“知识必增长”（但以理书 12:4）。当我们拥抱这些强大的工具时，愿我们也培养智慧，将它们用于善事，并铭记真正的进步不仅在于能力，更在于其合乎道德的应用。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: UK needs new laws for AI in healthcare, says watchdog
title.zh: 英国监管机构称医疗保健领域需要新的人工智能法律

summary.en: Britain's industry watchdog, the MHRA, has published 44 recommendations for updating policies as the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare, including the NHS, is set to become routine. The agency emphasizes the need for new regulations to ensure patient trust and confidence.
summary.zh: 英国的行业监管机构药品和保健品管理局（MHRA）发布了44项政策更新建议，因为人工智能（AI）在医疗保健领域的应用，包括国民医疗服务体系（NHS），将变得司空见惯。该机构强调需要新的法规来确保患者的信任和信心。

body.en:
The UK needs new regulations for AI products used in the NHS and other healthcare settings, says Britain's industry watchdog.

The Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency (MHRA), which regulates all medical devices and licenses treatment drugs in the UK, has published 44 recommendations to update its policies as the use of AI in the sector rises.

The technology will soon be routinely used within the NHS, MHRA chief Lawrence Tallon told the BBC.

"What I would expect is that patients will... increasingly see AI as part of the way that normal NHS healthcare is delivered," he said.

"That should happen in a way that they can maintain their trust and their confidence in what's happening."

The report was compiled by an independent commission and involved input from more than 12,000 people including patients and clinicians.

"The medical devices regulatory framework predominantly dates from a period where we were thinking about things like hip replacements and knee replacements, or smaller things like stethoscopes and plasters," Tallon said.

He added while current guidelines may work for simple AI products trained to spot known symptoms on scans, for example, the rules do not apply to more complex models.

"Unlike most of the medical products we're used to regulating, these products continue to change after the point of authorization," he said.

"I don't think at this moment in time we can point to a single country, a single regulatory framework, and say that they have absolutely cracked it," he said.

AI note-takers known as scribes, which are powered by LLMs, are reportedly used by 40% of UK-based GPs to record consultations and generate reports.

But a recent study from the University of Edinburgh found patients could be less likely to share personal information such as substance abuse history if they knew the conversation was being processed by AI.

Professor Henrietta Hughes, a GP who was part of the report commission, said that many of her patients were happy for AI being used during their consultations, but some chose to opt out.

Prof Hughes acknowledged that the scribes could make mistakes in their notes but said it was the responsibility of doctors to correct them.

While currently AI is more likely to be used to assist with administrative tasks, or carry out symptom spotting overseen by a human expert, there is a lot of excitement about its potential in the health and medical research industries.

Professor Alastair Denniston, an ophthalmologist who also worked on the report, described the technology as "an exceptional opportunity" for healthcare which was "likely to rank alongside step-changes such as antibiotics and MRI".

In September Rene Haas, the boss of chip designer Arm, told the BBC he believed the tech would come up...
body.zh: 英国行业监管机构表示，英国需要对 NHS 和其他医疗保健机构中使用的人工智能产品制定新的法规。 随着人工智能在该行业使​​用的增加，负责监管英国所有医疗设备和治疗药物许可的药品和保健产品监管机构 (MHRA) 发布了 44 条建议来更新其政策。 MHRA 负责人劳伦斯·塔伦 (Lawrence Tallon) 告诉 BBC，这项技术很快将在 NHS 内常规使用。 他说：“我期望患者……越来越多地将人工智能视为 NHS 提供正常医疗服务方式的一部分。” “这应该以一种他们能够保持对正在发生的事情的信任和信心的方式发生。” 该报告由一个独立委员会编写，涉及包括患者和临床医生在内的 12,000 多人的意见。 塔隆说：“医疗器械监管框架主要可以追溯到我们考虑髋关节置换术和膝关节置换术或听诊器和膏药等较小事物的时期。” 他补充说，虽然当前的指南可能适用于经过训练以在扫描中发现已知症状的简单人工智能产品，但这些规则不适用于更复杂的模型。 “与我们习惯监管的大多数医疗产品不同，这些产品在授权后会继续发生变化，”他说。 他说：“我认为目前我们不能针对某个国家、某个监管框架就说他们已经完全破解了这个问题。” 据报道，40% 的英国全科医生使用由法学硕士提供支持的人工智能笔记记录器（抄写员）来记录咨询并生成报告。 但爱丁堡大学最近的一项研究发现，如果患者知道对话正在由人工智能处理，他们就不太可能分享药物滥用历史等个人信息。 报告委员会成员之一的全科医生 Henrietta Hughes 教授表示，她的许多患者对在咨询过程中使用人工智能感到高兴，但有些人选择退出。 休斯教授承认抄写员可能会在笔记中犯错误，但表示医生有责任纠正这些错误。 虽然目前人工智能更有可能用于协助管理任务，或在人类专家的监督下进行症状发现，但它在健康和医学研究行业的潜力令人兴奋。 参与该报告撰写的眼科医生阿拉斯泰尔·丹尼斯顿 (Alastair Denniston) 教授将这项技术描述为医疗保健领域的“一次绝佳机会”，“可能与抗生素和核磁共振等重大技术进步并驾齐驱”。 9 月，芯片设计公司 Arm 的老板雷内·哈斯 (Rene Haas) 告诉 BBC，他相信这项技术将会出现……

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence becomes increasingly integrated into healthcare, the UK's MHRA is calling for updated regulations. This proactive approach, as highlighted by chief Lawrence Tallon, is crucial for maintaining public trust. It echoes the wisdom of Proverbs 27:12, which advises prudence and foresight when navigating new and potentially impactful...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能日益融入医疗保健领域，英国药品和保健品管理局（MHRA）呼吁更新相关法规。正如其负责人劳伦斯·塔隆所强调的，这种积极主动的方法对于维持公众信任至关重要。这呼应了箴言27:12的智慧，该经文建议在应对新的、可能产生重大影响的事态发展时要审慎和有远见。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Four groups caught using the same Chrome and Windows exploit kit
title.zh: 四组织利用相同的 Chrome 和 Windows 漏洞工具

summary.en: At least four hacking groups are actively using a nearly identical exploit kit, named BlueMoon by researchers, which targets critical vulnerabilities in Chromium-based browsers and older Windows versions. This kit chains together three vulnerabilities to install malware, exploiting two in Chromium and one in the...
summary.zh: 至少有四个黑客组织正在积极使用一个几乎相同的漏洞利用工具包，研究人员称之为 BlueMoon，该工具包针对 Chromium 内核浏览器和旧版 Windows 的关键漏洞。该工具包将三个漏洞链接起来，用于安装恶意软件，其中两个利用了 Chromium 的漏洞，一个利用了多个 Windows...

body.en: A nearly identical exploit kit that targets critical vulnerabilities in both Chromium-based browsers and older versions of Windows is being actively used by at least four hacking groups, some of which have ties to the Chinese government. Researchers from security firm Proofpoint said Wednesday that BlueMoon, the name they gave to the kit, chains three vulnerabilities together so the attackers using it can install malware of their choice. BlueMoon exploits two Chromium vulnerabilities and one in the kernel of Windows 10 (Oct. 2018 Update), Windows Server 2019, Windows 10 2004, Windows Server 2022, and the initial release of Windows 11. All three vulnerabilities have received patches in the past 24 hours. Deployed rapidly, widely shared The attacks lacked the stealth found in many campaigns. More often, hackers want to exploit newly discovered vulnerabilities sparingly to lengthen their longevity. Proofpoint hypothesized that one reason for the widely used and visible exploit chain was to take advantage of a “patch gap” in the Chromium supply chain, which spans the time a patch is available from developers and the time that patch is incorporated into browsers such as Chrome and Edge. Another likely contributor was the use of AI, which can often spot vulnerabilities faster than discovery performed solely by humans. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 至少四个黑客组织正在积极使用一个几乎相同的漏洞利用工具包，该工具包针对基于 Chromium 的浏览器和旧版本 Windows 中的关键漏洞，其中一些组织与中国政府有联系。安全公司 Proofpoint 的研究人员周三表示，他们给该套件起的名字 BlueMoon 将三个漏洞链接在一起，以便使用它的攻击者可以安装他们选择的恶意软件。 BlueMoon 利用了两个 Chromium 漏洞以及 Windows 10（2018 年 10 月更新）、Windows Server 2019、Windows 10 2004、Windows Server 2022 和 Windows 11 初始版本内核中的一个漏洞。所有这三个漏洞都在过去 24 小时内收到了补丁。部署迅速、广泛共享 这些攻击缺乏许多活动中的隐蔽性。更常见的是，黑客希望谨慎地利用新发现的漏洞来延长其寿命。 Proofpoint 假设，广泛使用且可见的漏洞利用链的一个原因是利用 Chromium 供应链中的“补丁间隙”，该间隙跨越了开发人员提供补丁的时间以及补丁被合并到 Chrome 和 Edge 等浏览器中的时间。另一个可能的贡献者是人工智能的使用，它通常可以比仅由人类执行的发现更快地发现漏洞。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, particularly in areas like AI-driven vulnerability discovery, presents a double-edged sword. While it can lead to innovation, it also accelerates the potential for misuse, as seen with the BlueMoon exploit kit. This mirrors the ancient observation that 'knowledge increases' in the latter days, urging us to seek wisdom...
reflection.zh: 技术的飞速发展，尤其是在人工智能驱动的漏洞发现等领域，是一把双刃剑。它既能带来创新，也加速了滥用的可能性，正如 BlueMoon 漏洞利用工具包所见。这与古老的观察相呼应，即末日“知识必增长”，这促使我们在技术进步的同时，寻求智慧和道德指引。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Europe may finally have found a space entrepreneur who is meeting the moment
title.zh: 欧洲可能终于找到了一个能抓住机遇的太空企业家

summary.en: French entrepreneur Hèlene Huby, CEO of The Exploration Company, has secured $450 million in Series C funding, marking the largest such round for a European space company. She is also serving as an envoy at a high-profile International Space Summit.
summary.zh: 法国企业家 Hèlene Huby，作为欧洲探索公司（The Exploration Company）的首席执行官，已成功获得 4.5 亿美元的 C 轮融资，创下了欧洲太空公司此类融资的最高纪录。她还担任法国总统马克龙召集的高级别国际空间峰会的一名特使。

body.en: All of a sudden, French entrepreneur Hèlene Huby is seemingly everywhere. This week she is serving as one of two envoys, alongside astronaut Thomas Pesquet, at a high-profile International Space Summit convened by French President Emmanuel Macron. The government's website for the event describes her as chief executive of "the fastest-growing space company in Europe." Also this week, that firm, The Exploration Company, announced a significant capital raise of $450 million in Series C funding. Although not spectacular by the standards of some US space businesses, this is the largest-ever Series C funding round by a Europe-based space company, and likely the largest funding round ever raised by a female-led company in Europe. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 突然间，法国企业家 Hèlene Huby 似乎无处不在。本周，她将作为两名特使之一，与宇航员托马斯·佩斯奎特一起，出席法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙召集的备受瞩目的国际太空峰会。该活动的政府网站将她描述为“欧洲发展最快的航天公司”的首席执行官。同样在本周，The Exploration Company 宣布在 C 轮融资中筹集 4.5 亿美元的资金。尽管按照一些美国航天企业的标准来看，这并不引人注目，但这是欧洲航天公司有史以来规模最大的 C 轮融资，也可能是欧洲女性领导的公司有史以来筹集的最大一轮融资。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Hèlene Huby's company, The Exploration Company, has achieved a significant milestone with a $450 million funding round. This success in the competitive space industry underscores the importance of diligent planning and execution in entrepreneurial endeavors. As Proverbs 16:3 states, 'Commit your works to Yahweh, and your plans will succeed.' This verse...
reflection.zh: Hèlene Huby 的公司“欧洲探索公司”通过 4.5 亿美元的融资轮达到了一个重要的里程碑。在竞争激烈的航天产业中取得这样的成功，凸显了创业活动中勤奋规划和执行的重要性。《箴言》16:3 说道：“你要将你的事交托雅伟，你所定的计就会成就。”这节经文提醒我们，虽然人的努力至关重要，但最终的成功在于将我们的事业托付给雅伟的指引。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
title.zh: 谷歌选择芬兰作为其在欧洲的最大单笔投资

summary.en: The US tech giant announces a record €13bn investment in Finland, primarily for AI infrastructure, including three new data centers and an expansion of an existing site. The project is expected to create tens of thousands of jobs and involves a 22-year agreement to purchase electricity from a nuclear power plant.
summary.zh: 这家美国科技巨头宣布了创纪录的130亿欧元投资芬兰，主要用于人工智能基础设施，包括三个新的数据中心和一个现有站点的扩建。该项目预计将创造数万个就业机会，并涉及一项为期22年的核电站电力购买协议。

body.en:
Google will buy up to half the electricity produced by one of Finland's nuclear power plants as part of a record €13bn (£11bn; $15bn) investment in the country's AI infrastructure, the company announced.

The US tech giant said the package would fund three new data centres, expand an existing site and support energy projects to power growing demand for AI services.

"This is Google's largest single investment in Europe and a testament to Finland's leadership in responsibly building AI infrastructure," the company said on Wednesday.

"Google's decision is a clear testament to our strengths," Finland's Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said in a statement.

As part of the deal, Google signed a 22-year contract with Finnish utility Fortum to buy up to 50% of the output from the Loviisa nuclear power plant.

Earlier this week, TikTok announced a $1bn investment in Finland to build a new data centre in Kouvola, pointing to the country's "strong digital infrastructure, clean energy mix, robust data governance and skilled tech talent".

Finland has emerged as an attractive location for data centres because of its cool climate, plentiful low-carbon electricity and relatively uncongested power grid. The colder temperatures can reduce the energy needed to cool facilities packed with computer servers.

Technology companies are racing to secure power supplies as the AI boom drives demand for vast networks of data centres.

The Google investment is expected to support more than 37,000 jobs during construction and boost Finland's GDP by €3.6bn a year, according to Google. Construction is set to take place in 2027 and 2028.

"The value of the data economy extends far beyond direct investment into spurring innovation, research and development," Orpo added.

"Deepening our collaboration with Google will deliver lasting benefits for both parties."

Google will build new data centres in Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala, while expanding its existing facility in Hamina, which it established after converting a former paper mill in 2009.

The infrastructure will help support products such as its AI chatbot Gemini, alongside services including Search, Maps and YouTube.

Google said the investments also covered "clean energy projects, and dedicated nature and community funds to support local biodiversity, education, research, and workforce development".

"Google is proud to deepen our roots in Finland," said Ruth Porat, president and chief investment officer of Alphabet and Google.

"This investment underscores Google's commitment to grow our presence responsibly, pairing the expansion of our technical infrastructure with new energy capacity, grid enhancements, and energy affordability initiatives," she added.
